results.title: The Evil Dead
results.overview: In 1979, a group of college students find a Sumerian Book of the Dead in an old wilderness cabin they've rented for a weekend getaway.

results.title: The Dead Zone
results.overview: Johnny Smith is a schoolteacher with his whole life ahead of him but, after leaving his fiancee's home one night, is involved in a car crash which leaves him in a coma for 5 years. When he wakes, he discovers he has an ability to see into the past, present and future life of anyone with whom he comes into physical contact.

results.title: Christine
results.overview: Nerdy high schooler Arnie Cunningham falls for Christine, a rusty 1958 Plymouth Fury, and becomes obsessed with restoring the classic automobile to her former glory. As the car changes, so does Arnie, whose newfound confidence turns to arrogance behind the wheel of his exotic beauty. Arnie's girlfriend Leigh and best friend Dennis reach out to him, only to be met by a Fury like no other.

results.title: Videodrome
results.overview: As the president of a trashy TV channel, Max Renn is desperate for new programming to attract viewers. When he happens upon "Videodrome," a TV show dedicated to gratuitous torture and punishment, Max sees a potential hit and broadcasts the show on his channel. However, after his girlfriend auditions for the show and never returns, Max investigates the truth behind Videodrome and discovers that the graphic violence may not be as fake as he thought.

results.title: Psycho II
results.overview: Norman Bates is declared sane and released from the facility in which he was being held, despite the complaints of Lila Loomis, sister of his most famous victim. Is he really cured, or will he kill again?

results.title: Cujo
results.overview: A friendly St. Bernard named "Cujo" contracts rabies and conducts a reign of terror on a small American town.

results.title: Angst
results.overview: A killer is released from prison and breaks into a remote home to kill a woman, her handicapped son and her pretty daughter.

results.title: The Hunger
results.overview: Five-thousand-year-old vampire Miriam promises her lovers the gift of eternal life. When John, her cellist companion for centuries, discovers that he has suddenly begun growing old, he attempts to seek out the help of Dr. Sarah Roberts, a researcher on the mechanisms of aging.

results.title: Michael Jackson's Thriller
results.overview: A night at the movies turns terrifying when Michael and his date are attacked by zombies. Released at the height of Thriller’s success, the short film redefined the music video, broke racial barriers, and became the first inducted into the U.S. National Film Registry.

results.title: Twilight Zone: The Movie
results.overview: An anthology film presenting remakes of three episodes from the "Twilight Zone" TV series—"Kick the Can", "It's a Good Life" and "Nightmare at 20,000 Feet"—and one original story, "Time Out."

results.title: Nightmares
results.overview: A collection of short stories. In one a woman who leaves her house late at night to drive to the store while a killer is loose encounters some problems. In the second an arcade whiz kid's obsession with a game leads to deadly consequences. In the third a small town priest loses his faith and decides to leave town, but in the desert is stalked by a mysterious black pick-up truck. In the final story, a family's problem with a rat is larger than they think.

results.title: Jaws 3-D
results.overview: A giant thirty-five-foot shark becomes trapped in a SeaWorld theme park and it's up to the sons of police chief Brody to rescue everyone.

results.title: Sleepaway Camp
results.overview: Years after a terrible boating accident, Angela is sent to Camp Arawak where a series of bizarre and violent "accidents" begin to claim the lives of various campers.

results.title: Amityville 3-D
results.overview: To debunk the Amityville house's infamous reputation and take advantage of a rock-bottom asking price, skeptical journalist John Baxter buys the place and settles in to write his first novel.

results.title: Of Unknown Origin
results.overview: A man who recently completed rebuilding a townhouse becomes obsessed with a rat infestation until it becomes an interspecies duel.

results.title: Something Wicked This Way Comes
results.overview: In a small American town, a diabolical circus arrives, granting wishes for the townsfolk, but twisted as only the esteemed Mr. Dark can make them. Can two young boys overcome the worst the devil himself can deal out?

results.title: The Keep
results.overview: Set during World War II, a German army garrison is sent to guard a mountain pass in a village in Romania's Carpathian mountains and sets up barracks in an ancient stone fortress. Two of the soldiers unwittingly release a mysterious entity that kills or corrupts those within its influence, drawing the attention of a Gestapo commander, a Jewish scholar, and a mysterious traveller.

results.title: House of the Long Shadows
results.overview: An American writer goes to a remote Welsh manor on a $20,000 bet that he can write a classic novel like 'Wuthering Heights' in 24 hours. However, upon his arrival he discovers that the apparently empty manor has several rather odd inhabitants.

results.title: Women's Prison Massacre
results.overview: Emanuelle is framed by a corrupt D.A. while investigating a drug smuggling operation and has to tough it out under lock and key, dealing with a strict warden and abusive guards.

results.title: A Blade in the Dark
results.original_title: La casa con la scala nel buio
results.overview: Bruno, an up and coming film composer, has been hired to write the score to a new horror movie. After moving into a secluded villa, life begins to imitate art as a vicious killer starts bumping off anyone and everyone who happens to pay him a visit.

results.title: The Prey
results.overview: Three young couples set off into the mountains for a weekend of climbing, drinking and lovemaking; little do they know that they are stumbling into the terrain of a fearsome predator – a wild man,  horrifically burned as a child many years ago in a fire which engulfed his gypsy camp and left only him alive, roaming the woods in search of his next human prey.

results.title: The Lift
results.overview: A lift technician finds himself drawn into a web of mystery and peril as he investigates the perplexing deadly accidents occurring in the elevators of a new office building.

results.title: Village of Doom
results.overview: Rejected by the military and frowned upon by his fellow villagers, a young man nicknamed 'Genius' falls into a series of dangerous love affairs during World War II.

results.title: Eyes of Fire
results.overview: In 1750, an adulterous preacher is ejected from a small British colony with his motley crew of followers, who make their way downriver to establish a new settlement of their own beyond the western frontier.

results.title: Olivia
results.overview: Nightmares of the past haunt the beautiful, mysterious Olivia, a London resident who begins a passionate affair with American businessman Mike. Trapped in a loveless marriage and traumatized by memories of her mother's brutal murder, Olivia hopes her lover will offer a chance at a new life. However, ghostly voices and brutal murders ignite a fiendish, twist-filled story of double identities, deception, and erotic terror.

results.title: BrainWaves
results.overview: After a traffic accident Kaylie is in coma for months and her doctors want to try a new procedure on her. To regain her consciousness, they stimulate her brain with the neural patterns of a woman who has just died. It works and Kaylie fully recovers. However, she begins to relive the dying moments of her donor and realizes that she was murdered! Along with her husband and mother, she tries to find out what happened.

results.title: Seeding of a Ghost
results.overview: After the wife of a taxi driver is raped and killed by two teenage hooligans, he pleads with a sorcerer to lift the hex and exact revenge.

results.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
results.overview: When a nobleman is threatened by a family curse on his newly inherited estate, detective Sherlock Holmes is hired to investigate.

results.title: The Boxer's Omen
results.overview: After his brother was crippled in the ring by a cheating Thai boxer,  Chan Hung goes to Thailand to avenge him, and finds the key to an omen which may release their family from an ancient curse. He is then caught up in a spiraling web of fate, Buddhist curses, and black magic.

results.title: The Beautiful Prisoner
results.overview: Walter is told by his boss, Sara, to deliver an urgent letter to Henri de Corinthe. On the way he finds a beautiful woman he had been eying in a nightclub, lying in the road, bound up. He takes her to a villa to get a doctor, and ends up being locked in a bedroom with her. While she is making love to him, he has visions of surrealistic images from René Magritte's paintings. In the morning, the girl, Marie-Ange, has vanished, the villa looks derelict, and his neck is bleeding. Was it all just a nightmare?

results.title: The Phantom of the Opera
results.overview: The Budapest Opera House's diva commits suicide after the owner ruins her career for having rejected his advances but her conductor-husband, believed killed in a fire, plans his revenge on all those he deems responsible for her suicide.

results.title: Harmagedon
results.overview: From the depths of space he is coming... Ancient beyond understanding, his power is immeasurable. He has destroyed half the universe and is on his way here. He is… Genma. Only two people are aware of the imminent catastrophe: Princess Luna, a modern day prophetess and Vega, a cybernetic crusader from a world long since ravaged by Genma. Determined to spare the Earth from a similar fate, Luna and Vega must try to mobilize the most potent psychics in the world. Together, this army of fledging psychic warriors must succeed where billions have tried... and failed. But will they be able to gather their champions in time? Genma’s agents are already on Earth to ensure that their master meets with no opposition!

results.title: Strange Invaders
results.overview: Alien beings, who settle in a small midwestern town, are disturbed by a young professor determined to rescue his daughter from their clutches.

results.title: The Appointment
results.overview: Prophetic nightmares precede a family's confrontation with an evil, unseen force.

results.title: The Beast and the Magic Sword
results.original_title: La bestia y la espada mágica
results.overview: His bloodline damned by a witch, Waldemar Daninsky heads to Japan to seek a cure for his werewolf curse.

results.title: Julie Darling
results.overview: A teenage girl whose inaction caused her mother's death arranges a similarly gruesome fate for her stepmother and brother.

results.title: Killing of the Flesh
results.overview: A group of decadent and filthy rich people arrive at the empty hotel where a deceased rich man lived. Soon they are copulating like crazy and the murders begin...

results.title: Angel of H.E.A.T. — The Protectors, Book #1
results.original_title: Angel of H.E.A.T. — The Protectors, Book #1
results.overview: Angel Harmony, a glamorous government agent, is tasked with stopping a mad scientist bent on world domination, whose weapons of choice include an army of androids and a device capable of disintegrating metal.

results.title: Ogroff
results.overview: Ogroff, an AWOL-solider-turned-hermit, lives in the French backwoods, and, still believing war to be raging, slaughters anyone who enters them. One day, a family's car breaks down in Ogroff's domain and a fight for their lives begins.

results.title: Extraterrestrial Visitors
results.overview: After a meteor-like object lands in the woods, poachers unearth a cave filled with alien eggs. As they attempt to destroy the eggs, one of them is killed by an unseen creature, leaving one egg intact. A young boy named Tommy finds the remaining egg and brings it home to hatch. As more murders occur around town, Tommy learns that his new pet alien, who he names Trumpy, possesses telekinetic powers.

results.title: The Being
results.overview: Toxic waste dumping in a small Idaho town turns a young boy into horrible mutant monster. The town's police chief and a government scientist team up to stop the monster, which is quickly killing off the town's citizenry.

results.title: Silent Death
results.overview: A masked assailant in an organized crime ring mutilates his victims with a straight razor.

results.title: Revenge of the Dead
results.overview: A young journalist buys a used typewriter and notices some text still legible on the ribbon; he reconstructs the story of a scientist who discovered that some types of terrain have the power to revive the dead.

results.title: Legend of the Cat Monster
results.overview: A legendary actress thought to be dead is discovered living in an isolated mansion. A screenwriter is tasked with writing her comeback film, which leads the two to live under the same roof.

results.title: Adam and Eve
results.original_title: Adamo ed Eva, la prima storia d'amore
results.overview: God casts Adam and Eve out of the Garden of Eden because Eve decided to have a fling with a visiting Cro-Magnon named Bearkiller. The disgraced couple find themselves on the outside up against an assortment of various dinosaurs, flying monsters and cannibals.

results.title: Esprit D'amour
results.overview: A young woman has a tragic accident, slipping on a skateboard and falling off the roof of a tall building. Koo Chi Ming, an insurance investigator, is sent to determine whether the girl's death is an accident or a suicide and he recognizes the young woman from an earlier chance encounter.

results.title: Demon Is on the Island
results.overview: An epidemic of appliance madness unrelated to discount sales strikes an island off the coast of France: the islanders are being murderously attacked by ovens and refrigerators acquired in the same department store. Enter the young Dr. Gabrielle Martin (Anny Duperey), who arrives here to escape her own personal tragedy and instead lands in the middle of the kitchen mania. She tracks down the cause of the rapidly spreading epidemic to another doctor on the island — quite as insane as any of the kitchen appliances (if the comparison could be made) — and finds that the villainous doctor and the appliances have a most unusual link. Graphic scenes of mutilation by an oven, as one example, leave nothing much to the imagination in this film, but the interpretations of actors Anny Duperey and Jean-Claude Brialy as the good and evil doctors are excellent.

results.title: Special Bulletin
results.overview: An evening of TV programming is interrupted by breaking news: in Charleston, South Carolina, two Coast Guard personnel and two members of a local news team have been taken hostage by a group of terrorists who are seeking to destroy the triggers of all local nuclear devices. Moreover, the terrorists threaten to detonate their own device if their demands are not met.

results.title: Diamonds of Kilimandjaro
results.original_title: El tesoro de la diosa blanca
results.overview: A group of adventurers head to a primitive tribe in Africa to find a treasure of diamonds and a beautiful white girl who was lost years ago and was made the tribe's goddess.

results.title: The Final Terror
results.overview: A group of friends head out for what is expected to be a vacation of hiking, camping and a good time, but when a backwoods mama finds them on her turf, it becomes anything but a vacation.

results.title: Mountaintop Motel Massacre
results.overview: After several years in an insane asylum, Evelyn, the keeper of the Mountaintop Motel, is released and resumes doing business. She kills her young charge out of anger, but convinces the police it was an accident - and pushed into insanity, she then proceeds to target her guests, first by releasing vermin into their rooms, but then by using her trusty sickle.

results.title: The Intercessor
results.overview: A writer seeking seclusion takes rooms in a remote farmhouse. Soon his quiet is broken by sounds and then sightings of a small child...

results.title: The Returning
results.overview: Two different men are possessed by spirits of Native Americans after they separately wander into a sacred burial ground. When John and Sybil come home with their son after a trip to the Mojave Desert, they bring an unusual stone back as a memento of the trip. The stone seems to cause strange noises and other horrible inexplicable phenomena.

results.title: Red Spell Spells Red
results.overview: An evil dwarf sorcerer is buried alive in the jungles of Borneo for practicing black magic: Many years later, a documentary film crew from Hong Kong opens the coffin, and discover that one of them is afflicted with a horrible curse that begins killing off everyone around them.

results.title: Blood Beat
results.overview: Sarah and her boyfriend have decided to spend Christmas at his home in rural Wisconsin. However, upon arriving, she begins to feel a strange presence around her, and a mysterious figure garbed in a Samurai outfit begins murdering the townsfolk.

results.title: The Demon Murder Case
results.overview: A young boy is taken over by demons who force him to commit murder.

results.title: Conquest
results.overview: To mark his passage into manhood, young Ilias is gifted a magical bow by his father and embarks upon a journey into the wilderness to rid the land of evil, all the while battling the witch Ocron, who wishes to steal the bow for her own nefarious ends.

results.title: Spasms
results.overview: A gigantic serpent is captured on a remote island and shipped to an American college for experimentation.

results.title: Deadly Lessons
results.overview: A psycho is stalking the students at an exclusive girls' school.

results.title: Dance of the Dwarfs
results.overview: An anthropologist and an alcoholic helicopter pilot discover a race of predatory reptile men in the jungles of South America.

/movie/764?append_to_response=credits.overview: In 1979, a group of college students find a Sumerian Book of the Dead in an old wilderness cabin they've rented for a weekend getaway.
/movie/764?append_to_response=credits.tagline: The ultimate experience in gruelling terror.
/movie/764?append_to_response=credits.title: The Evil Dead

/movie/11336?append_to_response=credits.overview: Johnny Smith is a schoolteacher with his whole life ahead of him but, after leaving his fiancee's home one night, is involved in a car crash which leaves him in a coma for 5 years. When he wakes, he discovers he has an ability to see into the past, present and future life of anyone with whom he comes into physical contact.
/movie/11336?append_to_response=credits.tagline: In his mind, he has the power to see the future. In his hands, he has the power to change it.
/movie/11336?append_to_response=credits.title: The Dead Zone

/movie/8769?append_to_response=credits.overview: Nerdy high schooler Arnie Cunningham falls for Christine, a rusty 1958 Plymouth Fury, and becomes obsessed with restoring the classic automobile to her former glory. As the car changes, so does Arnie, whose newfound confidence turns to arrogance behind the wheel of his exotic beauty. Arnie's girlfriend Leigh and best friend Dennis reach out to him, only to be met by a Fury like no other.
/movie/8769?append_to_response=credits.tagline: How do you kill something that can't possibly be alive?
/movie/8769?append_to_response=credits.title: Christine

/movie/837?append_to_response=credits.overview: As the president of a trashy TV channel, Max Renn is desperate for new programming to attract viewers. When he happens upon "Videodrome," a TV show dedicated to gratuitous torture and punishment, Max sees a potential hit and broadcasts the show on his channel. However, after his girlfriend auditions for the show and never returns, Max investigates the truth behind Videodrome and discovers that the graphic violence may not be as fake as he thought.
/movie/837?append_to_response=credits.tagline: First it controls your mind. Then it destroys your body.
/movie/837?append_to_response=credits.title: Videodrome

/movie/10576?append_to_response=credits.overview: Norman Bates is declared sane and released from the facility in which he was being held, despite the complaints of Lila Loomis, sister of his most famous victim. Is he really cured, or will he kill again?
/movie/10576?append_to_response=credits.tagline: It's 22 years later, and Norman Bates is coming home.
/movie/10576?append_to_response=credits.title: Psycho II

/movie/10489?append_to_response=credits.overview: A friendly St. Bernard named "Cujo" contracts rabies and conducts a reign of terror on a small American town.
/movie/10489?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Now, there's a new name for terror.
/movie/10489?append_to_response=credits.title: Cujo

/movie/18912?append_to_response=credits.overview: A killer is released from prison and breaks into a remote home to kill a woman, her handicapped son and her pretty daughter.
/movie/18912?append_to_response=credits.title: Angst

/movie/11654?append_to_response=credits.overview: Five-thousand-year-old vampire Miriam promises her lovers the gift of eternal life. When John, her cellist companion for centuries, discovers that he has suddenly begun growing old, he attempts to seek out the help of Dr. Sarah Roberts, a researcher on the mechanisms of aging.
/movie/11654?append_to_response=credits.title: The Hunger

/movie/92060?append_to_response=credits.overview: A night at the movies turns terrifying when Michael and his date are attacked by zombies. Released at the height of Thriller’s success, the short film redefined the music video, broke racial barriers, and became the first inducted into the U.S. National Film Registry.
/movie/92060?append_to_response=credits.title: Michael Jackson's Thriller

/movie/15301?append_to_response=credits.overview: An anthology film presenting remakes of three episodes from the "Twilight Zone" TV series—"Kick the Can", "It's a Good Life" and "Nightmare at 20,000 Feet"—and one original story, "Time Out."
/movie/15301?append_to_response=credits.tagline: You're travelling through another dimension. A dimension, not only of sight and sound, but of mind. A journey into a wondrous land whose boundaries are that of imagination. Next stop, the Twilight Zone!
/movie/15301?append_to_response=credits.title: Twilight Zone: The Movie

/movie/42114?append_to_response=credits.overview: A collection of short stories. In one a woman who leaves her house late at night to drive to the store while a killer is loose encounters some problems. In the second an arcade whiz kid's obsession with a game leads to deadly consequences. In the third a small town priest loses his faith and decides to leave town, but in the desert is stalked by a mysterious black pick-up truck. In the final story, a family's problem with a rat is larger than they think.
/movie/42114?append_to_response=credits.title: Nightmares

cast.character: William Henry Glazier (segment "Terror in Topanga") (as Lee James Jude)

/movie/17692?append_to_response=credits.overview: A giant thirty-five-foot shark becomes trapped in a SeaWorld theme park and it's up to the sons of police chief Brody to rescue everyone.
/movie/17692?append_to_response=credits.title: Jaws 3-D

/movie/13567?append_to_response=credits.overview: Years after a terrible boating accident, Angela is sent to Camp Arawak where a series of bizarre and violent "accidents" begin to claim the lives of various campers.
/movie/13567?append_to_response=credits.title: Sleepaway Camp

/movie/27214?append_to_response=credits.overview: To debunk the Amityville house's infamous reputation and take advantage of a rock-bottom asking price, skeptical journalist John Baxter buys the place and settles in to write his first novel.
/movie/27214?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Inside these walls, nothing is impossible... except survival.
/movie/27214?append_to_response=credits.title: Amityville 3-D

/movie/37227?append_to_response=credits.overview: A man who recently completed rebuilding a townhouse becomes obsessed with a rat infestation until it becomes an interspecies duel.
/movie/37227?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Two forces have claimed the house. Only one will survive.
/movie/37227?append_to_response=credits.title: Of Unknown Origin

/movie/24808?append_to_response=credits.overview: In a small American town, a diabolical circus arrives, granting wishes for the townsfolk, but twisted as only the esteemed Mr. Dark can make them. Can two young boys overcome the worst the devil himself can deal out?
/movie/24808?append_to_response=credits.tagline: What would you give a man who could make your deepest dream come true?
/movie/24808?append_to_response=credits.title: Something Wicked This Way Comes

/movie/26198?append_to_response=credits.overview: Set during World War II, a German army garrison is sent to guard a mountain pass in a village in Romania's Carpathian mountains and sets up barracks in an ancient stone fortress. Two of the soldiers unwittingly release a mysterious entity that kills or corrupts those within its influence, drawing the attention of a Gestapo commander, a Jewish scholar, and a mysterious traveller.
/movie/26198?append_to_response=credits.tagline: They were all drawn to the keep. Tonight, they will all face the evil.
/movie/26198?append_to_response=credits.title: The Keep

/movie/39164?append_to_response=credits.overview: An American writer goes to a remote Welsh manor on a $20,000 bet that he can write a classic novel like 'Wuthering Heights' in 24 hours. However, upon his arrival he discovers that the apparently empty manor has several rather odd inhabitants.
/movie/39164?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Room for every nightmare… A nightmare in every room.
/movie/39164?append_to_response=credits.title: House of the Long Shadows

/movie/45233?append_to_response=credits.overview: Emanuelle is framed by a corrupt D.A. while investigating a drug smuggling operation and has to tough it out under lock and key, dealing with a strict warden and abusive guards.
/movie/45233?append_to_response=credits.title: Women's Prison Massacre

/movie/39991?append_to_response=credits.original_title: La casa con la scala nel buio
/movie/39991?append_to_response=credits.overview: Bruno, an up and coming film composer, has been hired to write the score to a new horror movie. After moving into a secluded villa, life begins to imitate art as a vicious killer starts bumping off anyone and everyone who happens to pay him a visit.
/movie/39991?append_to_response=credits.title: A Blade in the Dark

/movie/70084?append_to_response=credits.overview: Three young couples set off into the mountains for a weekend of climbing, drinking and lovemaking; little do they know that they are stumbling into the terrain of a fearsome predator – a wild man,  horrifically burned as a child many years ago in a fire which engulfed his gypsy camp and left only him alive, roaming the woods in search of his next human prey.
/movie/70084?append_to_response=credits.tagline: It's not human, and it's got an axe!
/movie/70084?append_to_response=credits.title: The Prey

/movie/11417?append_to_response=credits.overview: A lift technician finds himself drawn into a web of mystery and peril as he investigates the perplexing deadly accidents occurring in the elevators of a new office building.
/movie/11417?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Take the stairs, take the stairs. For God's sake, take the Stairs!!!
/movie/11417?append_to_response=credits.title: The Lift

/movie/303146?append_to_response=credits.overview: Rejected by the military and frowned upon by his fellow villagers, a young man nicknamed 'Genius' falls into a series of dangerous love affairs during World War II.
/movie/303146?append_to_response=credits.tagline: WHAT'S WRONG WITH BEING A DEVIL?
/movie/303146?append_to_response=credits.title: Village of Doom

/movie/72349?append_to_response=credits.overview: In 1750, an adulterous preacher is ejected from a small British colony with his motley crew of followers, who make their way downriver to establish a new settlement of their own beyond the western frontier.
/movie/72349?append_to_response=credits.tagline: The secret is sleeping in the trees.
/movie/72349?append_to_response=credits.title: Eyes of Fire

/movie/224626?append_to_response=credits.overview: Nightmares of the past haunt the beautiful, mysterious Olivia, a London resident who begins a passionate affair with American businessman Mike. Trapped in a loveless marriage and traumatized by memories of her mother's brutal murder, Olivia hopes her lover will offer a chance at a new life. However, ghostly voices and brutal murders ignite a fiendish, twist-filled story of double identities, deception, and erotic terror.
/movie/224626?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Olivia is two women in one lovely body... one of them is about to commit murder!
/movie/224626?append_to_response=credits.title: Olivia

/movie/91609?append_to_response=credits.overview: After a traffic accident Kaylie is in coma for months and her doctors want to try a new procedure on her. To regain her consciousness, they stimulate her brain with the neural patterns of a woman who has just died. It works and Kaylie fully recovers. However, she begins to relive the dying moments of her donor and realizes that she was murdered! Along with her husband and mother, she tries to find out what happened.
/movie/91609?append_to_response=credits.tagline: They have violated the human mind.
/movie/91609?append_to_response=credits.title: BrainWaves

/movie/40070?append_to_response=credits.overview: After the wife of a taxi driver is raped and killed by two teenage hooligans, he pleads with a sorcerer to lift the hex and exact revenge.
/movie/40070?append_to_response=credits.title: Seeding of a Ghost

/movie/83579?append_to_response=credits.overview: When a nobleman is threatened by a family curse on his newly inherited estate, detective Sherlock Holmes is hired to investigate.
/movie/83579?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Holmes and Watson's most chilling case... an age-old curse... a ravenous monster...
/movie/83579?append_to_response=credits.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles

/movie/49239?append_to_response=credits.overview: After his brother was crippled in the ring by a cheating Thai boxer,  Chan Hung goes to Thailand to avenge him, and finds the key to an omen which may release their family from an ancient curse. He is then caught up in a spiraling web of fate, Buddhist curses, and black magic.
/movie/49239?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Mysterious! Intriguing! Horrifying! Don't miss it!
/movie/49239?append_to_response=credits.title: The Boxer's Omen

/movie/104338?append_to_response=credits.overview: Walter is told by his boss, Sara, to deliver an urgent letter to Henri de Corinthe. On the way he finds a beautiful woman he had been eying in a nightclub, lying in the road, bound up. He takes her to a villa to get a doctor, and ends up being locked in a bedroom with her. While she is making love to him, he has visions of surrealistic images from René Magritte's paintings. In the morning, the girl, Marie-Ange, has vanished, the villa looks derelict, and his neck is bleeding. Was it all just a nightmare?
/movie/104338?append_to_response=credits.title: The Beautiful Prisoner

/movie/354479?append_to_response=credits.overview: The Budapest Opera House's diva commits suicide after the owner ruins her career for having rejected his advances but her conductor-husband, believed killed in a fire, plans his revenge on all those he deems responsible for her suicide.
/movie/354479?append_to_response=credits.tagline: He committed unspeakable horrors...in the name of love.
/movie/354479?append_to_response=credits.title: The Phantom of the Opera

/movie/42076?append_to_response=credits.overview: From the depths of space he is coming... Ancient beyond understanding, his power is immeasurable. He has destroyed half the universe and is on his way here. He is… Genma. Only two people are aware of the imminent catastrophe: Princess Luna, a modern day prophetess and Vega, a cybernetic crusader from a world long since ravaged by Genma. Determined to spare the Earth from a similar fate, Luna and Vega must try to mobilize the most potent psychics in the world. Together, this army of fledging psychic warriors must succeed where billions have tried... and failed. But will they be able to gather their champions in time? Genma’s agents are already on Earth to ensure that their master meets with no opposition!
/movie/42076?append_to_response=credits.title: Harmagedon

/movie/47892?append_to_response=credits.overview: Alien beings, who settle in a small midwestern town, are disturbed by a young professor determined to rescue his daughter from their clutches.
/movie/47892?append_to_response=credits.tagline: 25 years ago, they arrived from another galaxy. Surprise — they're still here.
/movie/47892?append_to_response=credits.title: Strange Invaders

/movie/157276?append_to_response=credits.overview: Prophetic nightmares precede a family's confrontation with an evil, unseen force.
/movie/157276?append_to_response=credits.tagline: A chilling tale of the supernatural!
/movie/157276?append_to_response=credits.title: The Appointment

/movie/29909?append_to_response=credits.original_title: La bestia y la espada mágica
/movie/29909?append_to_response=credits.overview: His bloodline damned by a witch, Waldemar Daninsky heads to Japan to seek a cure for his werewolf curse.
/movie/29909?append_to_response=credits.title: The Beast and the Magic Sword

/movie/81475?append_to_response=credits.overview: A teenage girl whose inaction caused her mother's death arranges a similarly gruesome fate for her stepmother and brother.
/movie/81475?append_to_response=credits.tagline: She's sweet, sixteen, and she simply loves her daddy..... she'll slaughter you if you love him too.
/movie/81475?append_to_response=credits.title: Julie Darling

/movie/108072?append_to_response=credits.overview: A group of decadent and filthy rich people arrive at the empty hotel where a deceased rich man lived. Soon they are copulating like crazy and the murders begin...
/movie/108072?append_to_response=credits.title: Killing of the Flesh

/movie/29851?append_to_response=credits.original_title: Angel of H.E.A.T. — The Protectors, Book #1
/movie/29851?append_to_response=credits.overview: Angel Harmony, a glamorous government agent, is tasked with stopping a mad scientist bent on world domination, whose weapons of choice include an army of androids and a device capable of disintegrating metal.
/movie/29851?append_to_response=credits.title: Angel of H.E.A.T. — The Protectors, Book #1

/movie/105907?append_to_response=credits.overview: Ogroff, an AWOL-solider-turned-hermit, lives in the French backwoods, and, still believing war to be raging, slaughters anyone who enters them. One day, a family's car breaks down in Ogroff's domain and a fight for their lives begins.
/movie/105907?append_to_response=credits.tagline: For Ogroff, the mad lumberjack, the war is not over yet...
/movie/105907?append_to_response=credits.title: Ogroff

/movie/28445?append_to_response=credits.overview: After a meteor-like object lands in the woods, poachers unearth a cave filled with alien eggs. As they attempt to destroy the eggs, one of them is killed by an unseen creature, leaving one egg intact. A young boy named Tommy finds the remaining egg and brings it home to hatch. As more murders occur around town, Tommy learns that his new pet alien, who he names Trumpy, possesses telekinetic powers.
/movie/28445?append_to_response=credits.tagline: The Fate of the Earth is in Their Hands
/movie/28445?append_to_response=credits.title: Extraterrestrial Visitors

/movie/73218?append_to_response=credits.overview: Toxic waste dumping in a small Idaho town turns a young boy into horrible mutant monster. The town's police chief and a government scientist team up to stop the monster, which is quickly killing off the town's citizenry.
/movie/73218?append_to_response=credits.tagline: The ultimate terror has taken form...
/movie/73218?append_to_response=credits.title: The Being

/movie/776486?append_to_response=credits.overview: A masked assailant in an organized crime ring mutilates his victims with a straight razor.
/movie/776486?append_to_response=credits.title: Silent Death

/movie/38074?append_to_response=credits.overview: A young journalist buys a used typewriter and notices some text still legible on the ribbon; he reconstructs the story of a scientist who discovered that some types of terrain have the power to revive the dead.
/movie/38074?append_to_response=credits.tagline: One man's search for an ancient secret...and the dead will rise from their graves!
/movie/38074?append_to_response=credits.title: Revenge of the Dead

/movie/728189?append_to_response=credits.overview: A legendary actress thought to be dead is discovered living in an isolated mansion. A screenwriter is tasked with writing her comeback film, which leads the two to live under the same roof.
/movie/728189?append_to_response=credits.title: Legend of the Cat Monster

/movie/151717?append_to_response=credits.original_title: Adamo ed Eva, la prima storia d'amore
/movie/151717?append_to_response=credits.overview: God casts Adam and Eve out of the Garden of Eden because Eve decided to have a fling with a visiting Cro-Magnon named Bearkiller. The disgraced couple find themselves on the outside up against an assortment of various dinosaurs, flying monsters and cannibals.
/movie/151717?append_to_response=credits.title: Adam and Eve

/movie/119337?append_to_response=credits.overview: A young woman has a tragic accident, slipping on a skateboard and falling off the roof of a tall building. Koo Chi Ming, an insurance investigator, is sent to determine whether the girl's death is an accident or a suicide and he recognizes the young woman from an earlier chance encounter.
/movie/119337?append_to_response=credits.title: Esprit D'amour

/movie/11669?append_to_response=credits.overview: An epidemic of appliance madness unrelated to discount sales strikes an island off the coast of France: the islanders are being murderously attacked by ovens and refrigerators acquired in the same department store. Enter the young Dr. Gabrielle Martin (Anny Duperey), who arrives here to escape her own personal tragedy and instead lands in the middle of the kitchen mania. She tracks down the cause of the rapidly spreading epidemic to another doctor on the island — quite as insane as any of the kitchen appliances (if the comparison could be made) — and finds that the villainous doctor and the appliances have a most unusual link. Graphic scenes of mutilation by an oven, as one example, leave nothing much to the imagination in this film, but the interpretations of actors Anny Duperey and Jean-Claude Brialy as the good and evil doctors are excellent.
/movie/11669?append_to_response=credits.title: Demon Is on the Island

/movie/69266?append_to_response=credits.overview: An evening of TV programming is interrupted by breaking news: in Charleston, South Carolina, two Coast Guard personnel and two members of a local news team have been taken hostage by a group of terrorists who are seeking to destroy the triggers of all local nuclear devices. Moreover, the terrorists threaten to detonate their own device if their demands are not met.
/movie/69266?append_to_response=credits.title: Special Bulletin

/movie/28828?append_to_response=credits.original_title: El tesoro de la diosa blanca
/movie/28828?append_to_response=credits.overview: A group of adventurers head to a primitive tribe in Africa to find a treasure of diamonds and a beautiful white girl who was lost years ago and was made the tribe's goddess.
/movie/28828?append_to_response=credits.title: Diamonds of Kilimandjaro

/movie/4288?append_to_response=credits.overview: A group of friends head out for what is expected to be a vacation of hiking, camping and a good time, but when a backwoods mama finds them on her turf, it becomes anything but a vacation.
/movie/4288?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Without knowing they have awakened an unknown force. Can anyone survive?
/movie/4288?append_to_response=credits.title: The Final Terror

results.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
results.overview: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before. Krueger has now come back in the dreams of his killers' children, claiming their lives as his revenge. Nancy and her boyfriend, Glen, must devise a plan to lure the monster out of the realm of nightmares and into the real world...

results.title: Gremlins
results.overview: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

results.title: Nun in Rope Hell
results.original_title: 団鬼六　修道女縄地獄
results.overview: A woman gets caught by the wife of her lover which results in a stabbing. Feeling guilty she runs away and joins a nunnery. But she soon discovers that several nuns and a well known author have turned the place into their own personal S&M playground.

results.title: Children of the Corn
results.overview: A traveling couple end up in an abandoned Nebraska town inhabited by a cult of murderous children who worship a demon that lives in the local cornfields.

results.title: Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter
results.overview: After his revival in a hospital morgue, Jason fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

results.title: Lola's Secret
results.overview: A young man's dreams come true when the sexy new maid seduces him. But she has a secret that leads to trouble.

results.title: The Company of Wolves
results.overview: An adaptation of Angela Carter's fairy tales. Young Rosaleen dreams of a village in the dark woods, where Granny tells her cautionary tales in which innocent maidens are tempted by wolves who are hairy on the inside. As Rosaleen grows into womanhood, will the wolves come for her too?

results.title: Ghoulies
results.overview: A young man and his girlfriend move into the man's old mansion home, where he becomes possessed by a need to control ancient demons.

results.title: Rats: Night of Terror
results.overview: One hundred years after a nuclear war has devastated the planet, society has been reborn into two factions; the underground society and the scavangers above in the wastelands. A group of scavangers on bikes come across a town infested with flesh eating rats, and soon the gore is spilling everywhere.

results.title: C.H.U.D.
results.overview: A rash of bizarre murders in New York City seems to point to a group of grotesquely deformed vagrants living in the sewers. A courageous policeman, a photojournalist and his girlfriend, and a nutty bum, who seems to know a lot about the creatures, band together to try and determine what the creatures are and how to stop them.

results.title: The Toxic Avenger
results.overview: A gang of thugs devise a cruel hoax that goes horribly wrong as Melvin, a nerdy emaciated janitor at the local health club, is cast through a third story window into a vat of hazardous toxic waste.

results.title: Angel
results.overview: Molly Stewart, a teen at the top of her class who survives by working nights as a prostitute on Hollywood Blvd, finds her world beginning to fall apart when a depraved, necrophiliac serial killer begins targeting LA’s streetwalkers.

results.title: Ninja III: The Domination
results.overview: An aerobics instructor becomes a ruthless assassin after being possessed by a slain ninja's spirit, leading to a showdown with a martial arts expert.

results.title: Night of the Comet
results.overview: After a comet wipes out most of life on Earth, two Valley Girls find themselves fighting against cannibal zombies and a sinister group of scientists.

results.title: The Return of Godzilla
results.overview: After a fishing boat is attacked, the sole surviving crew member realizes it is none other than a resurrected Godzilla. However, efforts to bring the story to light are suppressed by the Japanese government amid growing political tensions between the United States and the Soviet Union, who are both willing to bomb Japan to stop the monster.

results.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night
results.overview: After a man dressed as Santa Claus brutally murders Billy Chapman's parents, little Billy then endures the cruelty of a sadistic nun at his orphanage. Years later, when adult Billy has to fill in for an absent in-store Santa, his childhood trauma brings him to the breaking point.

results.title: Hocus Pocus
results.overview: This movie follows in the same spirit as Mr. Vampire, Dead and the deadly and Spooky encounters, mixing comedy and horror!

When the killer begins to strike again, going in the order of the calendar itself, a hard nosed cop realizes that he needs to solve the mystery, or risk all of the models ending up in the morgue!

results.title: Sex Beyond the Grave

results.title: Night Shadows
results.overview: When brothers Josh and Mike go to a small southern town for a vacation, they find most of the residents either dead or missing. Mike soon disappears as well, leaving Josh to team up with the local sheriff and school teacher to find him in a town that’s hiding a dark, twisted secret.

results.title: The Criminal
results.overview: The Criminal has no dialogue, a fugitive who gets away from the death sentence but cannot escape from himself.

results.title: Frankenweenie
results.overview: When young Victor's pet dog Sparky (who stars in Victor's homemade monster movies) is hit by a car, Victor decides to bring him back to life the only way he knows how. But when the bolt-necked "monster" wreaks havoc and terror in the hearts of Victor's neighbors, he has to convince them (and his parents) that despite his appearance, Sparky's still the good loyal friend he's always been.

results.title: Razorback
results.overview: In the Australian outback a vicious wild boar kills and causes havoc to a small community.

results.title: Disconnected
results.overview: Lovely young Alicia starts receiving bizarre and disturbing phone calls after breaking up with her boyfriend Mike who she suspects is cheating on her with her twin sister Barbara Ann. Alicia meets and befriends amiable, but awkward film nerd Franklin, who alas turns out to be a total psycho with a penchant for carving up nubile ladies. But is Franklin the nutter responsible for those distressing phone calls?

results.title: Impulse
results.overview: After a small earthquake in a tiny, quiet town, local citizens start to exhibit bizarre, violent and self-destructive behaviour.

results.title: The Devil's Sword
results.overview: A legendary warrior embarks on a deadly quest to retrieve the cursed Devil’s Sword, a mystical weapon with dark powers capable of unleashing unimaginable destruction. When the sword falls into the wrong hands, chaos, and bloodshed follow. Now, it’s up to our hero to confront an army of evil warriors, deadly assassins, and supernatural creatures in a battle for the fate of the world.

results.title: The Occupant
results.overview: When a college student returns to her native Hong Kong to do academic work on Chinese superstitions, a goofy, lecherous realtor sets her up with a cheap apartment there, which she soon discovers is haunted by the spirit of a deceased singer.

results.title: Rocktober Blood
results.overview: A crazed rock singer returns from the dead to murder members of his former band.

results.title: Don't Open Till Christmas
results.overview: It's just days before Christmas in London, but not everyone is full of good cheer - as a maniac with a pathological hatred of Santa Claus stalks the streets, butchering any man that’s unlucky enough to be wandering around dressed as Old Saint Nick.

results.title: Monster Shark
results.overview: A marine biologist, a dolphin trainer, a research scientist, and a local sheriff try to hunt down a large sea monster, a shark/octopus hybrid, that is devouring swimmers and fishermen off a south Florida coast.

results.title: The Initiation
results.overview: An amnesiac sorority member who has been plagued by a recurring nightmare is stalked alongside other coeds by a killer in a deserted department store where they are completing a hazing ritual.

results.title: Lovingly Yours, Helen: The Movie
results.overview: This dramatic anthology of true-to-life stories of love and domestic problems based on letters sent by to the TV drama program hosted by Helen Vela who gives advice to troubled viewers.

results.title: Terror in the Aisles
results.overview: A non-stop roller coaster ride through the scariest moments of the greatest terror films of all time.

results.title: Blind Date
results.overview: A man goes blind when remembering his lost girlfriend, but the doctors can't find anything wrong with his eyes. They fit him with an experimental device which allows him to see with the aid of a computer interface and brain electrodes. Meanwhile, a taxi driver is taking young women up to their apartments, giving them gas, and performing a little fatal amateur surgery on them. Their paths inevitably converge, and the blind man must try to stop the psychopath.

results.title: Murder-Rock: Dancing Death
results.original_title: Murderock - Uccide a passo di danza
results.overview: The world of dance can be brutal.  The rehearsals are grueling.  The competition is fierce.  At the Arts for Living Centre in New York City, the best of the best are dying for a part in a major production.  But only a select few will be chosen.  The selection process seems to be at the hands of mysterious killer who pierces women's bare breasts with a hatpin, puncturing their hearts.  Ambition and jealousy appear to be the motive, which makes everybody a suspect!

results.title: Grandmothers Recharge Well!
results.overview: A family purchases a home robot designed to look like a grandmum. Their neighbours immediately buy a more expensivve model as the two families always try to up the other one. Both grandmums start to "terorize" their families because they were set up to ensure the mums exercise, the kids study etc. Apart from that they start causing problems to the other family ... cut ropes with hanging clothes, pierced tires, etc. Once they get to killing each other family's pets the parents get really worried about the safety of their kids. The grannys later destroy each other while fighting and the families decide that they'll be better off without any robots. (It's some time since I saw this so the details may be off.) Mainly thanks to the design of the robots it's rather a comedy than a horror. Unless you are ten. And a rather good comedy!

results.title: Marked
results.overview: Irma Auer (Satu Silvo) is a former call-girl, trying to distance herself from the past. In a séance she is told to be 'marked for death', and is afterward threatened by her former pimp and abandoned by her groom, as he learns about her past. Irma attempts to commit suicide, and resurrects at the city morgue after being pronounced dead. After the incident, she wanders out direction-less, being pursued by the doctor who treated her and also a strange, tall man.

results.title: The Surrogate
results.overview: Stuck in a sexless marriage, a frustrated well-to-do couple agrees to see a female sex therapist. Unfortunately, she only helps escalate the tensions between them. Meanwhile, the police are baffled by a string of brutal nightly killings.

results.title: Sole Survivor
results.overview: After inexplicably surviving a plane crash, TV station worker Denise tries to get on with her life. She soon learns that she was actually supposed to die in the crash. Death refuses to be cheated and starts sending its minions, people that have recently died, to collect her.

results.title: Boggy Creek II: And the Legend Continues
results.original_title: Boggy Creek II: And the Legend Continues
results.overview: Having heard tales of Bigfoot wreaking havoc in the swamps of Louisiana, a zoology professor sets out to investigate these strange occurrences for himself, aided by a ragtag team. Hitting the road in their camper, the group encounter person after person who relay their strange and often frightening encounters with the beast, while the creature itself remains elusive...

results.title: The Boy Who Left Home to Find Out About the Shivers
results.original_title: The Boy Who Left Home to Find Out About the Shivers
results.overview: An intelligent, fearless boy living in a superstitious Transylvanian village goes out into the world to figure out what everyone else is afraid of, "the shivers." A king hires him to rid his castle of ghosts and evil spirits, expecting him to die like all who have tried before him, but the boy is more fearless than he could have known.

results.title: Special Effects
results.overview: Reality and illusion collide as megalomaniacal filmmaker Chris Neville murders a young would-be actress, then sets about making a feature about the deed, casting the deceased's clueless husband as the patsy, and finding a dead ringer to play the late actress.

results.title: Heaven Can Help
results.overview: Mak is an optimist. He is driven to despair after a series of depressing events and got himself into a car accident. As he passed out, his spirit went to hell where the devils told him that he will die after the deaths of the Millionaire Wong, Ms Pao and Mr. Shek. At the same, a big bag is thrown at him from a passing car. In it is the dead body of Millionaire Wong. Mak turns to Shek's sister for help...

results.title: Paint Me a Murder
results.overview: Luke Lorenz is a artist whose paintings don't sell. His imaginative wife Sandra reasons that sales of his works would increase tenfold if he were to die, so they fake his death.

results.title: Taoism Drunkard
results.overview: A Taoist priest is ordered to find a Cherry Boy to appease his temple's ancestors. The boy in question is a young man who lives with his grandmother, trying to protect a sacred writ from a bright red, snarling bad guy. And let's just say insanity follows!

results.title: The Power
results.overview: A man comes into possession of an ancient Aztec doll. However, the doll is possessed by an evil spirit, which takes over his body.

results.title: The Sinister Doctor Orloff
results.overview: The son of the infamous Dr. Orloff clashes with his father when he begins to stalk and dismember prostitutes to get parts to reanimate his dead mother.

results.title: Frankenstein 90
results.overview: French cybernetics genius Victor Frankenstein carries on the work of his notorious ancestor and creates a monster, albeit one with a penchant for philosophy, etiquette and occasional bouts of murderous rage. But when the creature develops a hunger for l'amour, Frankenstein and his understanding fiancé use a cache of freshly murdered strippers to build the creature a beautiful yet dutiful bride. Can the undead find true love in a cold world, or will the French ways of passion unleash some monstrous surprises upon them all?

results.title: Night Has a Thousand Desires
results.overview: A telepathic nightclub act becomes the backdrop for murder.

results.title: The Ghost Informer
results.overview: Fire Unicom was killed by Tei Po under his violent fist. The spirit of Fire Unicorn discovered there would be illegal transaction between the gangsters. He informed inspector Tang this clue. After a fierce fight between he police and gangsters, the whole gang including Tei-po were being captured. Accidentally, Tang met Sally a model. She was so beautiful and charm that made Tang fell in love with her but she did not. Fire Unicorn being Tang's good friend decided to help him. Sally changed her mind and loved Tang. Unfortunately, Tei Po escaped from Jail and kidnapped Sally to an old castle. He vowed to take revenge on Tang. Would Tang Manage to save Sally from Tei Po's hand?
