/movie/21362?append_to_response=credits.overview: When a hotelier attempts to fill the chronic vacancies at his castle by launching an advertising campaign that falsely portrays the property as haunted, two actual ghosts show up and end up falling for two guests.
/movie/21362?append_to_response=credits.tagline: He's an American. She's a ghost. Vacation romances are always a hassle.
/movie/21362?append_to_response=credits.title: High Spirits

/movie/40095?append_to_response=credits.overview: Detective Roger Mortis is killed in action while investigating a string of mysterious robberies: until he's brought back from the dead with a chemical company's secret re-animation technology. Now he has twelve hours to solve the case of his own death before he dies: And stays dead.
/movie/40095?append_to_response=credits.tagline: You can't keep a good cop dead.
/movie/40095?append_to_response=credits.title: Dead Heat

/movie/27390?append_to_response=credits.original_title: Sorority Babes in the Slimeball Bowl-O-Rama
/movie/27390?append_to_response=credits.overview: Out to steal a trophy from a local bowling alley, a group of college students accidentally unleash the imp -- a sadistic little spirit that creates demons and loves sexy women.
/movie/27390?append_to_response=credits.tagline: In a bowling alley from Hell, there's only one way to score...
/movie/27390?append_to_response=credits.title: Sorority Babes in the Slimeball Bowl-O-Rama

/movie/40037?append_to_response=credits.overview: A talk show hostess takes a camera crew out to an abandoned factory to investigate a purported snuff film that was made there. As she gets closer to the truth, she and her friends are subjected to a brutal nightmare.
/movie/40037?append_to_response=credits.title: Evil Dead Trap

/movie/40028?append_to_response=credits.overview: An alien arrives on Earth looking to take human blood in an attempt to preserve his dying planet.
/movie/40028?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Traci must battle forces from another galaxy!
/movie/40028?append_to_response=credits.title: Not of This Earth

/movie/11347?append_to_response=credits.original_title: The Lair of the White Worm
/movie/11347?append_to_response=credits.overview: When an archaeologist uncovers a strange skull in a foreign land, the residents of a nearby town begin to disappear, leading to further inexplicable occurrences.
/movie/11347?append_to_response=credits.title: The Lair of the White Worm

/movie/10306?append_to_response=credits.overview: Carol Anne has been sent to live with her Aunt and Uncle in an effort to hide her from the clutches of the ghostly Reverend Kane, but he tracks her down and terrorises her in her relatives' appartment in a tall glass building. Will he finally achieve his target and capture Carol Anne again, or will Tangina be able, yet again, to thwart him?
/movie/10306?append_to_response=credits.tagline: No matter where Carol Anne goes... she never goes alone.
/movie/10306?append_to_response=credits.title: Poltergeist III

/movie/193084?append_to_response=credits.overview: A suspensefilled thriller about a successful single woman who, on a deserted road, picks up a mysterious hitchhiker. Once back in the city, "The Drifter" follows her every move. Every attempt to free herself of his harassment fails until the shocking conclusion is revealed!
/movie/193084?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Loving him was wrong. Dead wrong.
/movie/193084?append_to_response=credits.title: The Drifter

/movie/33172?append_to_response=credits.overview: A boy takes in a stray dog, later finding out that it's an ultra-intelligent runaway from a genetic research lab. Unbeknownst to him, the dog is being stalked by another escaped creature that's not quite so friendly.

production_companies.name: Canadian Entertainment Investors No. 2 and Company

/movie/33172?append_to_response=credits.tagline: It started as a secret experiment... It ended up as a new breed of terror.
/movie/33172?append_to_response=credits.title: Watchers

belongs_to_collection.name: Return of the Living Dead Collection

/movie/24929?append_to_response=credits.original_title: Return of the Living Dead Part II
/movie/24929?append_to_response=credits.overview: A group of kids discover one of the drums containing a rotting corpse and release the 2-4-5 Trioxin gas into the air, causing the dead to once again rise from the grave and seek out brains.
/movie/24929?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Just when you thought it was safe to be dead.
/movie/24929?append_to_response=credits.title: Return of the Living Dead Part II

/movie/49365?append_to_response=credits.overview: Locked in a school closet during Halloween 1962, young Frank witnesses the ghost of a young girl and the man who murdered her years ago.
/movie/49365?append_to_response=credits.tagline: The year is 1962. The place is Willowpoint Falls. Nobody talks about what happened in the school cloakroom 10 years ago. Now, in the dead of night, Frankie Scarlatti is going to find out why.
/movie/49365?append_to_response=credits.title: Lady in White

/movie/28452?append_to_response=credits.overview: People are dying mysteriously and gruesomely, and nobody has a clue what the cause is. Only health worker Mike Brady has a possible solution, but his theory of killer slugs is laughed at by the authorities. Only when the body count begins to rise and a slug expert from England begins snooping around does it begin to look like Mike had the right idea after all.
/movie/28452?append_to_response=credits.tagline: They ooze. They slime. They kill.
/movie/28452?append_to_response=credits.title: Slugs

/movie/25998?append_to_response=credits.overview: Japanese troops round up Chinese and Russian prisoners of war and take them to unit 731, where they're horribly tortured and experimented on to test new biological weapons.
/movie/25998?append_to_response=credits.title: Men Behind the Sun

/movie/351962?append_to_response=credits.original_title: 変態病棟 白衣責め
/movie/351962?append_to_response=credits.overview: During a month of unusually heavy rain in Tokyo, a mystery assailant has been brutally assaulting and killing people with a metal bat. When a handsome young man with amnesia is found outside an area hospital, the nurse who discovered him begins to suspect that he may in fact be the assailant. But her own strange erotic fixations with him, and the questionable involvement of the doctor tasked with the amnesia victim, lead them all down an increasingly twisted path of deeply-rooted trauma and violence.
/movie/351962?append_to_response=credits.title: Love Letter in the Sand

/movie/57744?append_to_response=credits.overview: After the death of her mother, a teenage girl is faced with bizarre supernatural occurrences when her mother's estranged sister arrives and begins to infiltrate her and her father's lives.
/movie/57744?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Don't do it with your eyes closed.
/movie/57744?append_to_response=credits.title: The Kiss

/movie/53355?append_to_response=credits.overview: Scientists poison the water supply of a small town, turning the residents into homicidal maniacs who kill each other and anybody who passes through.
/movie/53355?append_to_response=credits.title: Nightmare at Noon

/movie/27814?append_to_response=credits.overview: Brian comes under the addictive spell of a parasite with the ability to induce euphoric hallucinations in its hosts.
/movie/27814?append_to_response=credits.title: Brain Damage

/movie/15482?append_to_response=credits.overview: Crazy old Professor Gangreen has developed a way to make tomatoes look human for a second invasion.
/movie/15482?append_to_response=credits.tagline: They were out for blood, and rotten to the core. Now they're back ...
/movie/15482?append_to_response=credits.title: Return of the Killer Tomatoes!

cast.name: Costa Dillon
cast.character: Prison Guard / Man in parking lot / SAG representative / Product placement customer / Reporter

/movie/25854?append_to_response=credits.overview: A camera crew unearths a thousand year old vampire from Mesopotamia. Years after his rise from the grave, the vampire becomes a famous horror film director and holds auditions for his up and coming film. Four young hopefuls are chosen and are invited to spend the night at the vampire's house. At dinner the vampire reveals his true nature to his guests and the real reason why they are there, to kill him before dawn, as he has grown bored with his existence.
/movie/25854?append_to_response=credits.title: Dinner with a Vampire

/movie/3151?append_to_response=credits.overview: A mad doctor puts together a new body by using body parts he steals from a mortuary at the hospital where he works.
/movie/3151?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Patients aren't just dying to get in. They're dying to get out.
/movie/3151?append_to_response=credits.title: Frankenstein General Hospital

/movie/27412?append_to_response=credits.overview: Los Angeles private eye Jack Chandler is hired by a worried mother to find her missing runaway daughter, Samantha. As Chandler searches for her whereabouts, he uncovers an evil cult that worships an Egyptian god, whose followers commit human sacrifices with chainsaws to appease their deity. He soon learns that Samantha has revenge in store for the cult leader and his bevy of blood-thirsty, chainsaw-wielding hookers.
/movie/27412?append_to_response=credits.tagline: They charge an arm and a leg!
/movie/27412?append_to_response=credits.title: Hollywood Chainsaw Hookers

/movie/86680?append_to_response=credits.overview: A priest battles a demon that kills sinners in the act of sinning.
/movie/86680?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Seduction. Submission. Murder. Tonight... evil goes over the edge.
/movie/86680?append_to_response=credits.title: The Unholy

/movie/80640?append_to_response=credits.overview: Coerced by the evil Witch Raga, Ashura, the Hell Virgin, attempts to unlock the four Earth holes that lead to the Gates of Hell. Together, Raga aims to control the Earth. However, two monks skilful in magical powers set off on a journey to the cities to obstruct Ashura from unlocking the gates and stop Raga. Otherwise, not only will control of the Earth be at stake, but the King of Hell will resurrect and darkness will overcome the world.
/movie/80640?append_to_response=credits.title: The Peacock King

/movie/34311?append_to_response=credits.overview: Angela Baker escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more campers go missing, intrepid counselor Molly begins to piece together the truth.
/movie/34311?append_to_response=credits.title: Sleepaway Camp II: Unhappy Campers

/movie/81324?append_to_response=credits.overview: The trio of adventurous pals, a man who is a scientist, a fine lady and a former military pilot are in the Indochina jungles looking for some mysterious vase that holds a metal container that is of no mundane origin.
/movie/81324?append_to_response=credits.title: The Curse of Snake Valley

/movie/40549?append_to_response=credits.overview: Students from Miskatonic University decide to spend the night in the Winthrop house, a spot widely believed to have been haunted for the past 300 years, ever since Joshua Winthrop was horribly murdered and mutilated by the hideous creature born of his wife.
/movie/40549?append_to_response=credits.tagline: There are things on God's Earth that we can't explain and we can't describe.
/movie/40549?append_to_response=credits.title: The Unnamable

/movie/29095?append_to_response=credits.overview: Wealthy slacker Mark, his new girlfriend Sarah, and their friends, are invited to a special showing at a mysterious wax museum which displays eighteen of the most evil men of all time. After his ex-girlfriend and another friend disappear, Mark becomes suspicious…
/movie/29095?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Stop on by and give afterlife a try.
/movie/29095?append_to_response=credits.title: Waxwork

/movie/29315?append_to_response=credits.overview: A man and his daughter are attacked in the woods by what they believe is a Bigfoot-type creature. However, they soon begin to suspect that they may have stumbled onto a nest of aliens in a hidden spacecraft.
/movie/29315?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Enter a prime-evil world of future shock and alien terror.
/movie/29315?append_to_response=credits.title: Demonwarp

/movie/58797?append_to_response=credits.overview: A book artist, Whitney Taylor, is doomed to repeat history in a most grotesque way when she unleashes a demon after drawing it.
/movie/58797?append_to_response=credits.tagline: It'll Eat You Out Of House And Home...
/movie/58797?append_to_response=credits.title: Cellar Dweller

results.title: Pet Sematary
results.overview: After the Creed family's cat is accidentally killed, a friendly neighbor advises its burial in a mysterious nearby cemetery.

results.title: The 'Burbs
results.overview: When secretive new neighbors move in next door, suburbanite Ray Peterson and his friends let their paranoia get the best of them as they start to suspect the newcomers of evildoings and commence an investigation. But it's hardly how Ray, who much prefers drinking beer, reading his newspaper and watching a ball game on the tube expected to spend his vacation.

results.title: Midnight Matinee
results.overview: Even though a devastating murder took place during a small town's horror film festival two years earlier, townspeople want another festival.

results.title: The Fly II
results.overview: Martin Brundle, born of the human/fly, is adopted by his father's place of employment (Bartok Inc.) while the employees simply wait for his mutant chromosomes to come out of their dormant state.

results.title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
results.original_title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
results.overview: After lying in a coma for a year, Michael Myers awakens and stalks his way back to his small hometown in Illinois, intent on killing his niece, Jamie, who has been confined to a mental institution since his last attempt to slay her.

results.title: Vampire's Kiss
results.overview: A publishing executive is visited and bitten by a vampire and starts exhibiting erratic behavior. He pushes his secretary to extremes as he tries to come to terms with his affliction.

results.title: Warlock
results.overview: In 17th century New England, witch hunter Giles Redferne captures an evil warlock, but the conjurer eludes death with supernatural help. Flung into the future, the warlock winds up in the 1980s and plans to bring about the end of the world. Redferne follows the enchanter into the modern era and continues his mission, but runs into trouble in such unfamiliar surroundings. With the help of a young woman, can Redferne finally defeat the warlock?

results.title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
results.original_title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
results.overview: Jason ships out aboard a teen-filled "love boat" bound for New York, which he soon transforms into the ultimate voyage of the damned.

results.title: The Horror Show
results.overview: Vowing revenge on the detective who apprehended him, serial killer "Meat Cleaver" Max Jenke returns from beyond the grave to launch a whole new reign of terror.

results.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street: The Dream Child
results.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street: The Dream Child
results.overview: The pregnant Alice finds Freddy Krueger striking through the sleeping mind of her unborn child, hoping to be reborn into the real world.

results.title: Dead Calm
results.overview: An Australian couple takes a sailing trip in the Pacific to get over the recent loss of their son. While on the open sea, they come across a sinking ship with one survivor who is not at all what he seems.

results.title: Leviathan
results.overview: Underwater deep-sea miners encounter a Soviet wreck and bring back a dangerous cargo to their base on the ocean floor with horrifying results. The crew of the mining base must fight to survive against a genetic mutation that hunts them down one by one.

results.title: Godzilla vs. Biollante
results.overview: After the previous Godzilla attack, a miniature arms race ensues to collect his cells. Concerned over Godzilla's possible return, the Japanese government uses the cells to create a new bio-weapon, ANEB (Anti-Nuclear Energy Bacteria). They seeks the aid of geneticist Genshiro Shiragami, who's experiments result in a new mutation.

results.title: Lucky Sky Diamond
results.original_title: LSD -ラッキースカイダイアモンド-
results.overview: At the clinic where her boyfriend Katayama, a young genius doctor, is the director, Yoko, a young girl who continues to suffer from eerie nightmares every day, is not getting better despite the care of her sister Sakurako and Katayama's treatment. Sakurako, the sister, is suspicious of Yoko's condition and confronts Katayama, who tells her that she suffers from a serious mental disorder and that the only way to cure it is to have brain surgery. Yoko, despite being persuaded by her sister and Katayama, agrees to the surgery, although she is skeptical...

results.title: Cutting Class
results.overview: High school student Paula Carson's affections are being sought after by two of her classmates: Dwight, the "bad boy", and Brian, a disturbed young man who has just been released from a mental hospital where he was committed following the suspicious death of his father. Soon after being released, more murders start happening. Is Brian back to his old tricks, or is Dwight just trying to eliminate the competition?

results.title: Santa Sangre
results.overview: A former circus artist escapes from a mental hospital to rejoin his armless, cult leader mother, and is forced to enact brutal murders in her name.

results.title: The Church
results.overview: In a Gothic cathedral built on the mass grave of a Teutonic purge, an ancient discovery by the new librarian will release an unholy maelstrom of madness, violence, and demonic vengeance.

results.title: Stepfather 2
results.overview: "Stepfather" Jerry Blake escapes an insane asylum and winds up in another town, this time impersonating a marriage counselor. With a future wife and new stepson who love him, Blake eliminates anyone who stands in his way to building the perfect family.

results.title: Puppetmaster
results.overview: After being contacted by their mysterious former colleague, four psychics arrive at a secluded hotel where they are stalked by a group of murderous puppets.

results.title: Urotsukidōji: Legend of the Overfiend
results.original_title: 超神伝説 うろつき童子
results.overview: Legend has it that the human race is not the only dominant civilization living on Earth. Two other races exist in this world: the Makai (a demon race) and the Jujinkai (a half-man, half-beast race). Once every 3,000 years, a supreme being known as the Choujin (Overfiend) will emerge and bring balance to all three realms on Earth. In present-day Japan, after 300 years of endless searching, a Jujinkai named Amano Jyaku has discovered the presence of the Choujin inside high school slacker Tatsuo Nagumo. But now, Amano, along with his sister Megumi and their sidekick Kuroko, must protect Nagumo and his new girlfriend Akemi Ito from the Makai, who believe that Nagumo is not the Choujin, but an evil entity bent on destroying all living beings on Earth.

results.title: Tetsuo: The Iron Man
results.overview: A "metal fetishist", driven mad by the maggots wriggling in the wound he's made to embed metal into his flesh, runs out into the night and is accidentally run down by a Japanese businessman and his girlfriend. The pair dispose of the corpse in hopes of quietly moving on with their lives. However, the businessman soon finds that he is now plagued by a vicious curse that transforms his flesh into iron.

results.title: Buried Alive
results.overview: A young woman goes to teach at the Ravenscroft Institute, a spooky old girls' school overrun by ants and staffed by some unusual types. Spurred on by a series of horrific hallucinations, she begins to investigate the mysterious disappearances of several students.

results.title: Cannibal Women in the Avocado Jungle of Death
results.original_title: Cannibal Women in the Avocado Jungle of Death
results.overview: The U.S. government, eager to protect the nation's avocado supplies, recruits feminist professor Margo Hunt to make contact with the Piranha Women, an all-female tribe who believe men are only good as a source of food. Accompanying Dr. Hunt on her trip are Jim, a guide of questionable competence, and Bunny, a student of unquestionable incompetence.

results.title: Amityville: The Evil Escapes
results.overview: After moving into their matriarch's gothic seaside mansion, the Evans family soon becomes host to an uninvited demonic force in the form of a mysterious lamp that once resided in the Amityville house.

results.title: DeepStar Six
results.overview: The crew of an experimental underwater nuclear base are forced to struggle for their lives when their explorations disturb a creature who threatens to destroy their base.

results.title: I, Madman
results.overview: A bookshop clerk starts seeing the disfigured killer from her favorite 1950s pulp novels come to life and start killing people around her.

results.title: The Phantom of the Opera
results.overview: An aspiring opera singer finds herself transported back to Victorian-era London -- and into the arms of a reclusive, disfigured maestro determined to make her a star.

results.title: Sleepaway Camp III: Teenage Wasteland
results.overview: Psychotic Angela is itching to do what she does best: slaughter dozens of teenage campers. As luck would have it, the previous site of her murders has been renamed and converted into an experimental summer camp meant to bring together privileged and lower-class teens. On the day the youths are boarding the buses to camp, Angela runs over a potential camper with a garbage truck and assumes her identity. Once she has infiltrated the camp, the real terror begins.

results.title: The Toxic Avenger Part III: The Last Temptation of Toxie
results.original_title: The Toxic Avenger Part III: The Last Temptation of Toxie
results.overview: Desperate to raise money for the experimental surgery that could restore his blind fiancee's eyesight, Toxie accepts a lucrative job with the evil multinational conglomerate Apocalypse Inc.

results.title: Spontaneous Combustion
results.overview: A young man learns that his parents had been used in an atomic-weapons experiment shortly before his birth, and that the results have had some unexpected effects on him.

results.title: Angel Cop
results.overview: In the late twentieth century, the Secret Security Force was formed to stop the actions of the communist terrorist group known as the Red May. Angel, a beautiful, yet cold woman, has recently joined the small anti-terrorist group. But her first mission will be a true test of skill, for members of the Red May are being found dead, murdered by gruesome methods. Who is causing these murders? And why? Written by Chuck "Dark-Side" Williamson

results.title: Howling V: The Rebirth
results.overview: When a group of people from different walks of life converge in a Hungarian castle situated in Budapest which has been sealed for 500 years, they bring with them a werewolf which slowly begins to cut their numbers down.

results.title: The Return of Swamp Thing
results.overview: The Swamp Thing returns to battle the evil Dr. Arcane, who has a new science lab full of creatures transformed by genetic mutation, and chooses Heather Locklear as his new object of affection.

results.title: Moontrap
results.overview: The Space Shuttle returns to earth, but some of the equipment brought back on it begins to behave strangely. Scientists are unsure what is happening, and decide to take all necessary precautions.

results.title: American Rickshaw
results.overview: After a stripper tricks him into filming a sex tape, Miami rickshaw runner Scott Edwards becomes embroiled in the murder of a televangelist's son when he inadvertently takes the wrong videotape. With the help of the stripper and a witch, Edwards sets out to clear his name while avoiding the assassin dead-set on retrieving the tape.

results.title: Shocker
results.overview: About to be electrocuted for a catalog of heinous crimes, the unrepentant Horace Pinker transforms into a terrifying energy source. Only young athlete Jonathan Parker, with an uncanny connection to him through bizarre dreams, can fight the powerful demon.

results.title: Black Rainbow
results.overview: Martha Travis is a medium who makes contact with spirits "on the other side" and connects them with their loved ones still alive, in public performances. Trouble begins when she gives a message to Mary Kuron from her husband, Tom. But Tom isn't dead... yet. And Martha not only knows he will die, she also knows who killed him. And the murderer knows she knows...

results.title: Bloody Killer
results.overview: Taiwanese horror mystery from 1989.

results.title: After Midnight
results.overview: A college professor teaching a course called "The Psychology of Fear" brings his students (including a psychic) to his home, one dark and stormy night to tell scary stories. The first involves a young couple whose car breaks down by an old, abandoned house. The second has four trendy teenage girls getting lost in a bad part of town and chased by a pack of vicious dogs. Last, a woman on crutches confronting a stalker at the answering service where she works the night shift.

results.title: Beyond the Door III
results.overview: A shy co-ed and her classmates travel to Europe to see a ritual. With a satanist/professor with them, he lures them into deadly traps to become sacrifices to Satan. One co-ed is a virgin, the main key to bring Satan back to life. But can the co-ed lose her virginity before Satan controls the world?

results.title: My Mom's a Werewolf
results.overview: The frustrated housewife Leslie visits an animal shop to purchase a flea-collar. Unknowing that the owner is a werewolf, she accepts his invitation to lunch and later in his apartment. Through a bite in her toe he starts her slow transformation in a werewolf. Home again, she desperately tries to hide the often disgusting process from her family, but her daughter Jennifer and her - from horror magazines well educated - friend recognize what's going on, and help to kill the non-human.

results.title: Nightmare Beach
results.overview: In Miami, Florida, biker gang leader Edward "Diablo" Santer is about to be executed for murder when he proclaims his innocence and vows revenge from the grave. When a mysterious biker comes to town during Spring Break festivities, leaving several teenagers electrocuted to death, some begin to suspect that Santer has made good on his promise.

results.title: The Terror Within
results.overview: Experiments in biological warfare have destroyed all but a few remnants of the human race. Alone in a lab, eight students work feverishly to create a vaccine before they are forced outside in search for food. It is then that the surviving scientists discover creatures mutated by the plague. Now they prepare to do battle against their worst fear: The Terror Within.

results.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night III: Better Watch Out!
results.original_title: Silent Night, Deadly Night III: Better Watch Out!
results.overview: Ricky Caldwell, the notorious 'Killer Santa Claus', awakens from a six-year coma after being kept alive on life-support by a slightly crazed doctor experimenting with ESP and other special abilities. Ricky targets a young, clairvoyant blind woman, named Laura, whom is traveling with her brother Chris, and his girlfriend Jerri to their grandmother's house for Christmas Eve, and Ricky decides to go after her, leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake.

results.title: Slashdance
results.overview: Detective Tori Raines must go undercover when beautiful dancers start being brutally murdered at the Van Slake theatre.

results.title: Burning Sensation
results.overview: A firefighter salvages a spiritual shrine from an old burning building, which releases the gentle ghost of a Chinese opera singer, killed in a stage fire 30 years before. Grateful for saving her, the ghost falls for the firefighter and will stop at nothing to ensure his safety from the evils that lurk ahead. At the same time, the firefighter doesn't realize he is dating a ghost.

results.title: The Toxic Avenger Part II
results.overview: Melvin Junko was a nerdy weakling until he fell into a vat of toxic waste, turning him into the first ever superhuman creature from New Jersey. This time, he takes on Tokyo.

results.title: Parents
results.overview: Michael is a young boy living in a typical 1950s suburbanite home... except for his bizarre and horrific nightmares, and continued unease around his parents. Young Michael begins to suspect his parents are cooking more than just hamburgers on the grill outside, but has trouble explaining his fears to his new-found friend Sheila, or the school's social worker.

results.title: Night Game
results.overview: A police detective tracks a serial killer who is stalking young women on a beach front after each game that a baseball pitcher wins.

results.title: Vampire vs. Vampire
results.overview: To save the village from paranormal menaces, the One-Eyebrow Priest deals with and battles a host of mysterious creatures including: a little mischievous Chinese vampire; a lustful female ghost; the spirit of a woman murdered by a club owner and a European vampire and his blood-sucking pet bats.

results.title: A Whisper to a Scream
results.overview: A young girl who was frustrated in her desire to become an actress starts to work for a telephone-sex company. There she meets a fascinating man who has an obsession for music related with crime.

results.title: Etoile
results.overview: An American ballerina arrives in Hungary to enroll in a ballet school and it soon becomes apparent that things are not what they seem.

results.title: Sweet Home
results.overview: Working on a documentary about infamous painter Mamiya Ichiro, a TV crew filming at his old home come under attack from the ghost of the painter's wife.

results.title: Offerings
results.overview: Ten years after he was pushed down a well, a young man kills off the neighborhood bullies who tormented him and leaves their body parts as presents for the one girl who was kind to him.

results.title: Nick Knight
results.overview: Detective Nick Knight is investigating a series of murders in which the bodies are found drained of blood - but the most recent one doesn't fit the pattern. Instead it involves the cure that Nick has been searching for for decades, so that he himself can face the light of day. Later remade as the first two episodes of Forever Knight.

results.title: Arabella: Black Angel
results.overview: An insatiable nymphomaniac with a wheelchair-bound writer husband finds that her lurid exploits rejuvenate his creativity and libido, but soon enough, all of her lovers end up being murdered by an unknown assailant.

results.title: The Dead Pit
results.overview: The arrival of an amnesiac patient in a psychiatric hospital somehow frees a mad doctor, who was shot and entombed with his fiendish experiments in an abandoned wing of the asylum 20 years before.

results.title: Dead Silence
results.overview: Justice is served when mass murderer Sam Mason is put to death in the electric chair...or is it?  Would-be victim Terri is still haunted by Mason, and soon finds death is no deterrent for Mason's spirit as he is hellbent on putting the final nail in Terri's coffin.  On a desperate run for her life, Mason's spirit latches onto any unsuspecting soul in order to fulfill his quest to kill Terri. Can she escape from the horrors of the American justice system not having any application to dead criminals?

results.title: Chopper Chicks in Zombietown
results.overview: Riding around on their motorbikes, a gang of tough women bikers are the only thing that stands between a crowd of zombies, which have been accidentally let out of their secure cave, and those still alive in the town.

results.title: Girlfriend from Hell
results.overview: The inventor of the condom has become God's bounty hunter and is tasked with tracking down and capturing the Devil, who has possessed the body of a high school wallflower in order to feed on human souls via sex.

/movie/8913?append_to_response=credits.overview: After the Creed family's cat is accidentally killed, a friendly neighbor advises its burial in a mysterious nearby cemetery.
/movie/8913?append_to_response=credits.title: Pet Sematary

/movie/11974?append_to_response=credits.overview: When secretive new neighbors move in next door, suburbanite Ray Peterson and his friends let their paranoia get the best of them as they start to suspect the newcomers of evildoings and commence an investigation. But it's hardly how Ray, who much prefers drinking beer, reading his newspaper and watching a ball game on the tube expected to spend his vacation.
/movie/11974?append_to_response=credits.tagline: He's a man of peace in a savage land... Suburbia.
/movie/11974?append_to_response=credits.title: The 'Burbs

/movie/137051?append_to_response=credits.title: Midnight Matinee

/movie/10344?append_to_response=credits.overview: Martin Brundle, born of the human/fly, is adopted by his father's place of employment (Bartok Inc.) while the employees simply wait for his mutant chromosomes to come out of their dormant state.
/movie/10344?append_to_response=credits.title: The Fly II

/movie/11361?append_to_response=credits.original_title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
/movie/11361?append_to_response=credits.overview: After lying in a coma for a year, Michael Myers awakens and stalks his way back to his small hometown in Illinois, intent on killing his niece, Jamie, who has been confined to a mental institution since his last attempt to slay her.
/movie/11361?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Michael lives. AND THIS TIME THEY'RE READY!
/movie/11361?append_to_response=credits.title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers

/movie/7091?append_to_response=credits.overview: A publishing executive is visited and bitten by a vampire and starts exhibiting erratic behavior. He pushes his secretary to extremes as he tries to come to terms with his affliction.

/movie/7091?append_to_response=credits.title: Vampire's Kiss

/movie/11342?append_to_response=credits.overview: In 17th century New England, witch hunter Giles Redferne captures an evil warlock, but the conjurer eludes death with supernatural help. Flung into the future, the warlock winds up in the 1980s and plans to bring about the end of the world. Redferne follows the enchanter into the modern era and continues his mission, but runs into trouble in such unfamiliar surroundings. With the help of a young woman, can Redferne finally defeat the warlock?
/movie/11342?append_to_response=credits.title: Warlock

/movie/10283?append_to_response=credits.original_title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
/movie/10283?append_to_response=credits.overview: Jason ships out aboard a teen-filled "love boat" bound for New York, which he soon transforms into the ultimate voyage of the damned.
/movie/10283?append_to_response=credits.tagline: New York has a new problem.
/movie/10283?append_to_response=credits.title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan

/movie/38084?append_to_response=credits.title: The Horror Show

/movie/10160?append_to_response=credits.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street: The Dream Child

/movie/10493?append_to_response=credits.overview: An Australian couple takes a sailing trip in the Pacific to get over the recent loss of their son. While on the open sea, they come across a sinking ship with one survivor who is not at all what he seems.
/movie/10493?append_to_response=credits.tagline: High seas. Deep terror. Try to stay calm.
/movie/10493?append_to_response=credits.title: Dead Calm

/movie/14372?append_to_response=credits.overview: Underwater deep-sea miners encounter a Soviet wreck and bring back a dangerous cargo to their base on the ocean floor with horrifying results. The crew of the mining base must fight to survive against a genetic mutation that hunts them down one by one.
/movie/14372?append_to_response=credits.tagline: How long can you hold your breath?
/movie/14372?append_to_response=credits.title: Leviathan

/movie/18289?append_to_response=credits.overview: After the previous Godzilla attack, a miniature arms race ensues to collect his cells. Concerned over Godzilla's possible return, the Japanese government uses the cells to create a new bio-weapon, ANEB (Anti-Nuclear Energy Bacteria). They seeks the aid of geneticist Genshiro Shiragami, who's experiments result in a new mutation.
/movie/18289?append_to_response=credits.tagline: The winner of this battle would be the most enormous enemy against human beings.
/movie/18289?append_to_response=credits.title: Godzilla vs. Biollante

Sakurako, the sister, is suspicious of Yoko's condition and confronts Katayama, who tells her that she suffers from a serious mental disorder and that the only way to cure it is to have brain surgery. Yoko, despite being persuaded by her sister and Katayama, agrees to the surgery, although she is skeptical...
/movie/223319?append_to_response=credits.title: Lucky Sky Diamond

/movie/21799?append_to_response=credits.overview: High school student Paula Carson's affections are being sought after by two of her classmates: Dwight, the "bad boy", and Brian, a disturbed young man who has just been released from a mental hospital where he was committed following the suspicious death of his father. Soon after being released, more murders start happening. Is Brian back to his old tricks, or is Dwight just trying to eliminate the competition?
/movie/21799?append_to_response=credits.tagline: No one said surviving high school would be easy.
/movie/21799?append_to_response=credits.title: Cutting Class

/movie/19236?append_to_response=credits.overview: A former circus artist escapes from a mental hospital to rejoin his armless, cult leader mother, and is forced to enact brutal murders in her name.
/movie/19236?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Forget Everything You Have Ever Seen...
/movie/19236?append_to_response=credits.title: Santa Sangre

/movie/40364?append_to_response=credits.overview: In a Gothic cathedral built on the mass grave of a Teutonic purge, an ancient discovery by the new librarian will release an unholy maelstrom of madness, violence, and demonic vengeance.
/movie/40364?append_to_response=credits.title: The Church

/movie/30666?append_to_response=credits.overview: "Stepfather" Jerry Blake escapes an insane asylum and winds up in another town, this time impersonating a marriage counselor. With a future wife and new stepson who love him, Blake eliminates anyone who stands in his way to building the perfect family.
/movie/30666?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Tonight - Daddy's coming home - to slice up more than just the cake!
/movie/30666?append_to_response=credits.title: Stepfather 2

/movie/26953?append_to_response=credits.overview: After being contacted by their mysterious former colleague, four psychics arrive at a secluded hotel where they are stalked by a group of murderous puppets.
/movie/26953?append_to_response=credits.title: Puppetmaster

/movie/48624?append_to_response=credits.original_title: 超神伝説 うろつき童子
/movie/48624?append_to_response=credits.overview: Legend has it that the human race is not the only dominant civilization living on Earth. Two other races exist in this world: the Makai (a demon race) and the Jujinkai (a half-man, half-beast race). Once every 3,000 years, a supreme being known as the Choujin (Overfiend) will emerge and bring balance to all three realms on Earth. In present-day Japan, after 300 years of endless searching, a Jujinkai named Amano Jyaku has discovered the presence of the Choujin inside high school slacker Tatsuo Nagumo. But now, Amano, along with his sister Megumi and their sidekick Kuroko, must protect Nagumo and his new girlfriend Akemi Ito from the Makai, who believe that Nagumo is not the Choujin, but an evil entity bent on destroying all living beings on Earth.
/movie/48624?append_to_response=credits.title: Urotsukidōji: Legend of the Overfiend

/movie/41428?append_to_response=credits.overview: A "metal fetishist", driven mad by the maggots wriggling in the wound he's made to embed metal into his flesh, runs out into the night and is accidentally run down by a Japanese businessman and his girlfriend. The pair dispose of the corpse in hopes of quietly moving on with their lives. However, the businessman soon finds that he is now plagued by a vicious curse that transforms his flesh into iron.
/movie/41428?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Metal invades the flesh. Murder consumes the mind.
/movie/41428?append_to_response=credits.title: Tetsuo: The Iron Man

/movie/30711?append_to_response=credits.overview: A young woman goes to teach at the Ravenscroft Institute, a spooky old girls' school overrun by ants and staffed by some unusual types. Spurred on by a series of horrific hallucinations, she begins to investigate the mysterious disappearances of several students.
/movie/30711?append_to_response=credits.title: Buried Alive

/movie/26369?append_to_response=credits.original_title: Cannibal Women in the Avocado Jungle of Death
/movie/26369?append_to_response=credits.overview: The U.S. government, eager to protect the nation's avocado supplies, recruits feminist professor Margo Hunt to make contact with the Piranha Women, an all-female tribe who believe men are only good as a source of food. Accompanying Dr. Hunt on her trip are Jim, a guide of questionable competence, and Bunny, a student of unquestionable incompetence.
/movie/26369?append_to_response=credits.tagline: These women are serious about their taste in men.
/movie/26369?append_to_response=credits.title: Cannibal Women in the Avocado Jungle of Death

/movie/55377?append_to_response=credits.overview: After moving into their matriarch's gothic seaside mansion, the Evans family soon becomes host to an uninvited demonic force in the form of a mysterious lamp that once resided in the Amityville house.
/movie/55377?append_to_response=credits.tagline: From the creators of the original AMITYVILLE comes the most terrifying chapter...
/movie/55377?append_to_response=credits.title: Amityville: The Evil Escapes

/movie/11607?append_to_response=credits.overview: The crew of an experimental underwater nuclear base are forced to struggle for their lives when their explorations disturb a creature who threatens to destroy their base.
/movie/11607?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Not All Aliens Come From Space. Save Your Last Breath... To Scream.
/movie/11607?append_to_response=credits.title: DeepStar Six

/movie/40353?append_to_response=credits.overview: A bookshop clerk starts seeing the disfigured killer from her favorite 1950s pulp novels come to life and start killing people around her.
/movie/40353?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Lose Yourself in a Good Book.
/movie/40353?append_to_response=credits.title: I, Madman

/movie/86962?append_to_response=credits.overview: An aspiring opera singer finds herself transported back to Victorian-era London -- and into the arms of a reclusive, disfigured maestro determined to make her a star.
/movie/86962?append_to_response=credits.tagline: ROBERT ENGLUND Was "Freddy." Now he's the... Phantom OF THE OPERA!
/movie/86962?append_to_response=credits.title: The Phantom of the Opera

/movie/34312?append_to_response=credits.overview: Psychotic Angela is itching to do what she does best: slaughter dozens of teenage campers. As luck would have it, the previous site of her murders has been renamed and converted into an experimental summer camp meant to bring together privileged and lower-class teens. On the day the youths are boarding the buses to camp, Angela runs over a potential camper with a garbage truck and assumes her identity. Once she has infiltrated the camp, the real terror begins.
/movie/34312?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Angela... the angel of death is back!
/movie/34312?append_to_response=credits.title: Sleepaway Camp III: Teenage Wasteland

/movie/28169?append_to_response=credits.original_title: The Toxic Avenger Part III: The Last Temptation of Toxie

/movie/28169?append_to_response=credits.title: The Toxic Avenger Part III: The Last Temptation of Toxie

/movie/39195?append_to_response=credits.title: Spontaneous Combustion

/movie/37629?append_to_response=credits.overview: In the late twentieth century, the Secret Security Force was formed to stop the actions of the communist terrorist group known as the Red May. Angel, a beautiful, yet cold woman, has recently joined the small anti-terrorist group. But her first mission will be a true test of skill, for members of the Red May are being found dead, murdered by gruesome methods. Who is causing these murders? And why? Written by Chuck "Dark-Side" Williamson
/movie/37629?append_to_response=credits.tagline: In a nightmare future, violence is the only law
/movie/37629?append_to_response=credits.title: Angel Cop

/movie/35945?append_to_response=credits.overview: When a group of people from different walks of life converge in a Hungarian castle situated in Budapest which has been sealed for 500 years, they bring with them a werewolf which slowly begins to cut their numbers down.
/movie/35945?append_to_response=credits.title: Howling V: The Rebirth

/movie/19142?append_to_response=credits.overview: The Swamp Thing returns to battle the evil Dr. Arcane, who has a new science lab full of creatures transformed by genetic mutation, and chooses Heather Locklear as his new object of affection.
/movie/19142?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Why can't men be more like plants?
/movie/19142?append_to_response=credits.title: The Return of Swamp Thing

/movie/14916?append_to_response=credits.overview: The Space Shuttle returns to earth, but some of the equipment brought back on it begins to behave strangely. Scientists are unsure what is happening, and decide to take all necessary precautions.
/movie/14916?append_to_response=credits.tagline: 14,000 Years It Has Waited For Us
/movie/14916?append_to_response=credits.title: Moontrap

/movie/208759?append_to_response=credits.overview: After a stripper tricks him into filming a sex tape, Miami rickshaw runner Scott Edwards becomes embroiled in the murder of a televangelist's son when he inadvertently takes the wrong videotape. With the help of the stripper and a witch, Edwards sets out to clear his name while avoiding the assassin dead-set on retrieving the tape.
/movie/208759?append_to_response=credits.title: American Rickshaw

/movie/12521?append_to_response=credits.overview: About to be electrocuted for a catalog of heinous crimes, the unrepentant Horace Pinker transforms into a terrifying energy source. Only young athlete Jonathan Parker, with an uncanny connection to him through bizarre dreams, can fight the powerful demon.
/movie/12521?append_to_response=credits.title: Shocker

/movie/71373?append_to_response=credits.overview: Martha Travis is a medium who makes contact with spirits "on the other side" and connects them with their loved ones still alive, in public performances. Trouble begins when she gives a message to Mary Kuron from her husband, Tom. But Tom isn't dead... yet. And Martha not only knows he will die, she also knows who killed him. And the murderer knows she knows...
/movie/71373?append_to_response=credits.tagline: She has just witnessed a murder that hasn't happened yet.
/movie/71373?append_to_response=credits.title: Black Rainbow

/movie/66192?append_to_response=credits.overview: A college professor teaching a course called "The Psychology of Fear" brings his students (including a psychic) to his home, one dark and stormy night to tell scary stories. The first involves a young couple whose car breaks down by an old, abandoned house. The second has four trendy teenage girls getting lost in a bad part of town and chased by a pack of vicious dogs. Last, a woman on crutches confronting a stalker at the answering service where she works the night shift.
/movie/66192?append_to_response=credits.title: After Midnight

/movie/33767?append_to_response=credits.overview: A shy co-ed and her classmates travel to Europe to see a ritual. With a satanist/professor with them, he lures them into deadly traps to become sacrifices to Satan. One co-ed is a virgin, the main key to bring Satan back to life. But can the co-ed lose her virginity before Satan controls the world?
/movie/33767?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Some doors are best left closed!
/movie/33767?append_to_response=credits.title: Beyond the Door III

/movie/2199?append_to_response=credits.overview: The frustrated housewife Leslie visits an animal shop to purchase a flea-collar. Unknowing that the owner is a werewolf, she accepts his invitation to lunch and later in his apartment. Through a bite in her toe he starts her slow transformation in a werewolf. Home again, she desperately tries to hide the often disgusting process from her family, but her daughter Jennifer and her - from horror magazines well educated - friend recognize what's going on, and help to kill the non-human.
/movie/2199?append_to_response=credits.tagline: Jennifer's mother is having an identity crisis.
/movie/2199?append_to_response=credits.title: My Mom's a Werewolf

/movie/74646?append_to_response=credits.overview: In Miami, Florida, biker gang leader Edward "Diablo" Santer is about to be executed for murder when he proclaims his innocence and vows revenge from the grave. When a mysterious biker comes to town during Spring Break festivities, leaving several teenagers electrocuted to death, some begin to suspect that Santer has made good on his promise.
/movie/74646?append_to_response=credits.title: Nightmare Beach

/movie/29345?append_to_response=credits.overview: Experiments in biological warfare have destroyed all but a few remnants of the human race. Alone in a lab, eight students work feverishly to create a vaccine before they are forced outside in search for food. It is then that the surviving scientists discover creatures mutated by the plague. Now they prepare to do battle against their worst fear: The Terror Within.
/movie/29345?append_to_response=credits.title: The Terror Within

/movie/42709?append_to_response=credits.original_title: Silent Night, Deadly Night III: Better Watch Out!
/movie/42709?append_to_response=credits.overview: Ricky Caldwell, the notorious 'Killer Santa Claus', awakens from a six-year coma after being kept alive on life-support by a slightly crazed doctor experimenting with ESP and other special abilities. Ricky targets a young, clairvoyant blind woman, named Laura, whom is traveling with her brother Chris, and his girlfriend Jerri to their grandmother's house for Christmas Eve, and Ricky decides to go after her, leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake.
/movie/42709?append_to_response=credits.tagline: When your nightmare ends, the real terror begins!
/movie/42709?append_to_response=credits.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night III: Better Watch Out!

/movie/97693?append_to_response=credits.overview: Detective Tori Raines must go undercover when beautiful dancers start being brutally murdered at the Van Slake theatre.
/movie/97693?append_to_response=credits.tagline: SAVE THE LAST DANCE... FOR HELL!
/movie/97693?append_to_response=credits.title: Slashdance

/movie/172744?append_to_response=credits.overview: A firefighter salvages a spiritual shrine from an old burning building, which releases the gentle ghost of a Chinese opera singer, killed in a stage fire 30 years before. Grateful for saving her, the ghost falls for the firefighter and will stop at nothing to ensure his safety from the evils that lurk ahead. At the same time, the firefighter doesn't realize he is dating a ghost.
/movie/172744?append_to_response=credits.title: Burning Sensation

/movie/28165?append_to_response=credits.tagline: The first super-hero from New Jersey is back!
/movie/28165?append_to_response=credits.title: The Toxic Avenger Part II

/movie/27607?append_to_response=credits.overview: Michael is a young boy living in a typical 1950s suburbanite home... except for his bizarre and horrific nightmares, and continued unease around his parents. Young Michael begins to suspect his parents are cooking more than just hamburgers on the grill outside, but has trouble explaining his fears to his new-found friend Sheila, or the school's social worker.
/movie/27607?append_to_response=credits.tagline: There's A New Name For Terror...
/movie/27607?append_to_response=credits.title: Parents

/movie/84071?append_to_response=credits.overview: A police detective tracks a serial killer who is stalking young women on a beach front after each game that a baseball pitcher wins.
/movie/84071?append_to_response=credits.title: Night Game

/movie/67350?append_to_response=credits.overview: To save the village from paranormal menaces, the One-Eyebrow Priest deals with and battles a host of mysterious creatures including: a little mischievous Chinese vampire; a lustful female ghost; the spirit of a woman murdered by a club owner and a European vampire and his blood-sucking pet bats.
/movie/67350?append_to_response=credits.title: Vampire vs. Vampire

results.title: The Exorcist III
results.overview: On the fifteenth anniversary of the exorcism that claimed Father Damien Karras' life, Police Lieutenant Kinderman's world is once again shattered when a boy is found decapitated and savagely crucified.

results.title: Tremors
results.overview: Val McKee and Earl Bassett are in a fight for their lives when they discover that their desolate town has been infested with gigantic, man-eating creatures that live below the ground.

results.title: Jacob's Ladder
results.overview: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie, and ex-wife, Sarah, try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis, fails to reach him as he descends into madness.

results.title: Child's Play 2
results.overview: Chucky is reconstructed by a toy factory to dispel the negative publicity surrounding the doll, and tracks young Andy Barclay to a foster home where the chase begins again.

results.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
results.overview: Young sweethearts Billy and Kate move to the Big Apple, land jobs in a high-tech office park and soon reunite with the friendly and lovable Gizmo. But a series of accidents creates a whole new generation of Gremlins. The situation worsens when the devilish green creatures invade a top-secret laboratory and develop genetically altered powers, making them even harder to destroy!

results.title: Dark Angel
results.overview: Jack Caine is a Houston vice cop who's forgotten the rule book. His self-appointed mission is to stop the drugs trade and the number one supplier Victor Manning. While involved in an undercover operation to entrap Victor Manning, his partner is killed, and a sinister newcomer enters the scene...

results.title: Night of the Living Dead
results.overview: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

results.title: Flatliners
results.overview: Five medical students experiment with "near death" experiences, until the dark consequences of past tragedies begin to jeopardize their lives.

results.title: Nightbreed
results.overview: A troubled young man is drawn to a mythical place called Midian where a variety of friendly monsters are hiding from humanity. Meanwhile, a sadistic serial killer is looking for a patsy.

results.title: Erotic Ghost Story
results.overview: After one thousand years, three vixens transform into humans. They seduce a poor young scholar who soon finds himself in a horrifying situation.

results.title: Bride of Re-Animator
results.overview: Unperturbed by the disastrous outcome of his previous meddling with the dead, Dr. West continues his research into the phenomenon of re-animation; only this time, he plans to create life – starting with the heart of his young protégé Dan's dearly deceased Meg Halsey.

results.title: The Witches
results.overview: While staying at a hotel in England with his grandmother, Helga, a young boy named Luke inadvertently spies on a convention of witches. The Grand High Witch reveals a plan to turn all children into mice via a magical formula. When they discover the eavesdropper, the witches test the formula on him. Now, with the help of Helga and hotel manager Mr Stringer, Luke the mouse must fight back against the witches.

results.title: Maniac Cop 2
results.overview: Undead cop Matt Cordell rises from the grave, and is after the criminals who murdered him in prison.

results.title: Graveyard Shift
results.overview: John Hall is a drifter who wanders into a small town in Maine. He needs a job and decides to seek employment at the community's top business: a large textile mill. He is hired to work the "graveyard shift" -- from around midnight to dawn -- and, along with a few others, he is charged with cleaning out the basement. This task strikes the workers as simple enough, but then, as they proceed deeper underground, they encounter an unspeakable monstrosity intent on devouring them all.

results.title: Two Evil Eyes
results.overview: A duo of Edgar Allan Poe adaptations about a greedy wife's attempt to embezzle her dying husband's fortune, and a sleazy reporter's adoption of a strange black cat.

results.title: Society
results.overview: Bill Whitney is worried that he is different to his sister and parents. They mix with other upper-class people while Bill is more down to earth. Even his girlfriend seems a bit odd. All is revealed when Bill returns home to find a party in full swing.

results.title: The Amityville Curse
results.overview: After purchasing a property in Amityville, New York, Debbie and her husband invite three of their closest friends to help renovate. Immediately uneasy in her new surroundings, she begins experiencing shockingly vivid nightmares.

results.title: Leatherface: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre III
results.original_title: Leatherface: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre III

/movie/36992?append_to_response=credits.title: Shakma

results.overview: On the planet Phaebon, a controlled research facility had been thought to be safe... until a breach unleashes alien terrors unknown.

results.title: Poison
results.overview: A trio of interweaved transgressive tales, telling a bizarre stories of suburban patricide and a miraculous flight from justice, a mad sex experiment which unleashes a disfiguring plague, and the obsessive sexual relationship between two prison inmates.

results.title: Begotten
results.overview: Begotten is the creation myth brought to life, the story of no less than the violent death of God and the (re)birth of nature on a barren earth.

results.title: Sundown: The Vampire in Retreat
results.overview: Reclusive vampires lounge in a lonely American town. They wear sunscreen to protect themselves. A descendant of Van Helsing arrives with hilarious consequences.

results.title: Cast a Deadly Spell
results.overview: In a fantastical 1940s where magic is used by everyone, a hard-boiled detective investigates the theft of a mystical tome.

results.title: Sometimes They Come Back
results.overview: Desperate for a job to help him support his family, Jim Norman takes a position teaching high school in the town where his brother was murdered in front of him by teenage bullies twenty-seven years before. The teens who committed the crime are long dead, but now the kids in Jim's new class keep dying and being replaced by new students who look like the deceased hoodlums.

results.title: 964 Pinocchio
results.overview: While wandering around Japan, defective sex cyborg Pinocchio encounters Kyoko, another amnesiac burdened with a terrible secret tied to her amnesia. Together, they strive to rebuild their lives in a world where memory has become obsolete.

results.title: Body Parts
results.overview: A criminal psychologist loses his arm in a car crash, and becomes one of three patients to have their missing limbs replaced by those belonging to an executed serial killer. One of them dies violently, and disturbing occurrences start happening to the surviving two.

results.title: Take Me
results.overview: Milk's husband dies on their wedding night while having sex. He returns as a ghost as she attempts to get her life back on track whilst choosing between two new men in her life.

results.title: The Borrower
results.overview: Aliens punish one of their own by sending him to earth. The alien is very violent, and when the body he occupies is damaged, he is forced to find another.

results.title: Ghost Story of Kam Pin Mui
results.overview: A quartet of sexy naked vampires and their ghostly family, helmed by Wu Ma, haunt the village of Kam Pin Mui in this traditional tale of good and evil.

results.title: Not of This World
results.overview: An alien life form lands on earth and begins to feed off electricity, making it grow to enormous size. The authorities must stop it as it slithers cross-country towards a nuclear power plant.

results.title: Dolly Dearest
results.overview: An American family moves to Mexico to fabricate dolls, but their toy factory happens to be next to a Sanzian grave and the toys come into possession of an old, malicious spirit.

results.title: The Terror Within II
results.overview: In a world gone mad, the last human colony struggles to survive underground, beneath a land of nightmarish mutants who seek to destroy them. But when the mutant breaks inside humanity's final stronghold, the battle for survival pits the human colonists against their deadly invaders miles below the earth's surface.

results.title: An Eternal Combat
results.overview: In late 15th century China, The Master, a Taoist priest, has been destined to fight the Japanese Demon King; a vengeful spirit who has power over the forest. The Demon King has fallen in love with a woman named Gigi and forces her to be his bride. As The Master begins his fateful battle with the Demon King, they’re unexpectedly thrust into a time vortex which transports them 500 years into the future to modern-day Hong Kong wherein they discover Gigi’s reincarnation, who is being terrorized by her vicious ex-boyfriend, Ben.

results.title: Ernest Scared Stupid
results.overview: Well-intentioned, eternally bumbling Ernest P. Worrell accidentally releases an evil demon from its sacred tomb. As the demon flexes its power and goes on a ruinous rampage, good-guy Ernest tries to step in to save the town from mass destruction. Trouble is, a 200-year-old curse has scared Ernest stupid, and that means hilarity all around! So, kick back and let the laugh-ridden adventures begin.

results.title: Highway to Hell
results.overview: Charlie and Rachel run away from home to get married in Las Vegas. But they get attacked by a zombie who takes Rachel with him to hell, where she will become one of Satan's brides.

results.title: The Unborn
results.overview: Joy turns to horror when a pregnant mother discovers the nightmarish truth behind her doctor's unexpected success in helping her conceive.

results.title: Alligator 2: The Mutation
results.overview: A giant mutated alligator runs riot in a small town after the sewer system washes it into a lake.

results.title: The Restaurant of Many Orders
results.overview: A short film based on a story by Japanese writer Kenji Miyazawa in which two young British hunters get lost in the woods and discover a strange restaurant. Are the hunters about to discover how it feels to be hunted?

results.title: Nekromantik 2
results.overview: Monika lives with Rob, a corpse she loves. Her dilemma intensifies when she meets Mark and considers a normal life with him. She must choose between her affection for Rob and a new relationship.

results.title: The Pit and the Pendulum
results.overview: Set during the height of Spanish Inquisition. The beautiful and kind-hearted Maria is arrested as a witch when she inadvertently cries out in horror at the public whipping of a child. As Maria’s husband Antonio tries to save her, Torquemada, the Grand Inquisitor, determines to punish Maria with torture for the desire she inflames in him. Loosely based on Edgar Allen Poe's classic short story.

results.title: The Runestone
results.overview: A New York detective takes the case of a bulletproof monster sprung to life from Viking legend.

results.title: Mermaid Forest
results.overview: There is a legend in Japan that if one eats the flesh of a mermaid, one will become immortal. This anime recounts the story of Yuhta and Mana, an immortal boy and girl, and their experiences with a family struggling to achieve immortality at any cost.

results.title: Lunatics: A Love Story
results.overview: In the seedy part of Los Angeles, a man who writes poetry has spent six months without leaving his apartment because of his paranoid delusions involving sadistic doctors, rappers, and spiders. A woman who seems to jinx things by wanting to help is dumped by her boyfriend and finds herself penniless on the streets, and soon runs afoul of a local gang. Due to a telephone glitch, the man calls her at a phone booth trying to dial a "talk line" and invites her to his place. There they must help each other to overcome their respective problems.

results.title: Flowers in the Mirror, Wind and Moon: Ghost Appears
results.overview: Horror movie from Taiwan.

results.title: The Holy Virgin Versus the Evil Dead
results.overview: A teacher and his five female students are attacked by a monster with neon-green eyes. The teacher escapes but his students are completely dismembered. He soon discovers the monster is worshipped by a cult whose ambition is to rule the world and tear the clothes off young girls.

results.title: Killer Tomatoes Strike Back!
results.overview: Police assitant Boyle along with tomatologist Kennedi Johnson look into investigations about Killer Tomato attacks, and discover Gangrene plans to brainwash people via TV talk shows to take over the world! Will Gangrene be stopped? Will Johnson become part of a Bacon, Lettuce and Human sandwich?

results.title: Strays
results.overview: A young married couple and their daughter are terrorized by a pride of ferocious feral felines.

results.title: Erotic Ghost Story II
results.overview: Wu Tung, the lascivious demon of carnal desire, falls for one of his conquests, only to see her destroyed. He demands the girl's village to regularly send him a virgin or face his wrath. One of the girls has his lover's spirit within her.

results.title: Happy Hell Night
results.overview: 25 years ago at Winfield College, psycho-priest Zachary Malius murdered seven frat boys and was put away in the local asylum. Now, however, the same fraternity stages a prank from which Malius is inadvertently set free and returns to the house to repeat his crime...

results.title: Ghost
results.overview: Paranormal documentary in which investigators talk about ghosts, and eyewitnesses explain their paranormal experiences.

results.title: Popcorn
results.overview: While holding a horror film festival, a group of students are stalked by a madman who may have a sinister connection to a cult leader.

results.title: Spiritual Trinity
results.overview: Two ghostexterminators have been married for many years. But they encounter a ghost they can not manage on their own and therefore ask the wife's old boyfriend for help. This leads to a love triangle while the ghost is stronger than they had imagined.

results.title: Undying Love
results.overview: A young man (Tommy Sweeney) who's depressed about his failed suicide attempt, winds up going to a friends party anyway. Although his friends seem insensitive about his plight, he meets a model who sheds a different light on death.

results.title: Child of Darkness, Child of Light
results.original_title: Child of Darkness, Child of Light
results.overview: A Catholic priest is sent to investigate reports of two virgin conceptions. One is about to give birth to the child of God and the other is the child of the Devil and he must decide which one is good and which one is evil before Satan's followers can stop him.

results.title: Scream Queen Hot Tub Party
results.overview: Five of Hollywood's leading scream queens get together in a creepy mansion and decide to get in the hot tub (as true scream queens would). They talk in the tub and exchange secrets on the do's and don'ts of being a scream queen.

results.title: Intensive Care
results.overview: A deranged doctor gets in to a car accident and burns beyond recognition. Years later he awakes from his coma and stalks a young male nurse and his girlfriend, killing everyone along the way.

results.title: Bloodsucking Pharaohs in Pittsburgh
results.overview: A police detective teams up with his buddy's daughter to investigate cult-ritual mutilations.

results.title: There's Nothing Out There
results.overview: Mike's obsession with horror movies means he can't help but expect to find a monster lurking around every corner. When he joins his friends for a weekend away at a remote lodge, Mike instantly senses that something isn't right. Can Mike use his movie knowledge to save his pals from a bloody end?

results.title: Class of Nuke 'Em High 2: Subhumanoid Meltdown
results.original_title: Class of Nuke 'Em High 2: Subhumanoid Meltdown
results.overview: At the Tromaville Institute of Technology's nuclear plant, Prof. Holt has perfected "subhumanoids": living beings without emotions who perform menial tasks. When school reporter Roger Smith meets a beautiful subhumanoid named Victoria, they fall in love and he becomes determined to save her and the school from a giant mutant squirrel, Tromie.

results.title: Science Crazed
results.overview: A mad scientist injects a woman with an untested growth serum. She dies, but gives birth to a full-grown monster.

results.title: Curse III: Blood Sacrifice
results.overview: When an American plantation owner's wife and her sister interrupt an African death ritual to save the sacrificial goat, the witch doctor places a curse on them, summoning a god from the sea to slaughter them and anyone in its way with a panga, a curved, African machete.

results.title: Judge
results.overview: An executive accused of murder by his own victim is brought before the court of the dead to answer for his crimes.

results.title: Howling VI: The Freaks
results.overview: A villainous carnival owner traps a young werewolf to include in his growing menagerie of inhuman exhibits.

results.title: Clearcut
results.overview: A white lawyer finds his values shaken when he is paired with an angry Indigenous activist who insists on kidnapping the head of a logging company to teach him the price of his destruction.

results.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night 5: The Toy Maker
results.original_title: Silent Night, Deadly Night 5: The Toy Maker
results.overview: A toy maker's creations display some very human -- and deadly -- tendencies.

results.title: Hiruko the Goblin

Hiruko is a goblin sent to Earth on a reconnaissance mission. He beheads students in order to assemble their heads on the demons' spider-like bodies. Hieda, an archaeology professor, and Masao, a haunted student, investigate the gory deaths.

results.title: Turtle Vision
results.original_title: 盗撮レポート 陰写！
results.overview: A professional voyeuristic filmmaker is hired to acquire footage of prostitutes; during the process, his camera lands on a woman with a troubled past.

results.title: Death Becomes Her
results.overview: Madeline is married to Ernest, who was once her arch-rival Helen's fiancé. After recovering from a mental breakdown, Helen vows to kill Madeline and steal back Ernest. Unfortunately for everyone, the introduction of a magic potion causes things to be a great deal more complicated than a mere murder plot.

results.title: Alien³
results.overview: After escaping with Newt and Hicks from the alien planet, Ripley crash lands on Fiorina 161, a prison planet and host to a correctional facility. Unfortunately, although Newt and Hicks do not survive the crash, a more unwelcome visitor does. The prison does not allow weapons of any kind, and with aid being a long time away, the prisoners must simply survive in any way they can.

results.overview: Ash, a handsome, shotgun-toting, chainsaw-armed department store clerk, is time warped backwards into England's Dark Ages, where he romances a beauty and faces legions of the undead.

results.title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
results.overview: Count Dracula, a 15th-century prince, is condemned to live off the blood of the living for eternity. Young lawyer Jonathan Harker is sent to Dracula's castle to finalise a land deal, but when the Count sees a photo of Harker's fiancée, Mina, the spitting image of his dead wife, he imprisons him and sets off for London to track her down.

results.title: Erotic Ghost Story III
